m: Amendement van het lid Belhaj c.s. over doorgang van het programma Participatie en Taal
Shifts 1.3 million euro within the budget of article 13 to keep the Participatie en Taal programme for asylum seekers running in 2022.
This amendment provides that 1.3 million is made available for the Participatie en Taal programme in 2022.
Dit amendement regelt dat er 1,3 miljoen wordt vrijgemaakt voor het programma Participatie en Taal in het jaar 2022.
Motie van het lid Palland c.s. over zo spoedig mogelijk zekerheid bieden over borging, kwaliteit en continuïteit van de onderwijsroute
Asks the government to quickly provide certainty on the funding, quality and continuity of the integration education route.
requests the government to provide certainty as soon as possible on the funding, quality and continuity of the education route
verzoekt de regering om zo spoedig mogelijk zekerheid te bieden over de borging, kwaliteit en de continuïteit van de onderwijsroute
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over nieuwkomers die in het oude inburgeringsstelsel instromen zo veel mogelijk laten profiteren van de voorwaarden van de Wet inburgering 2021
Asks the government to do everything possible so that newcomers entering under the old integration system benefit as much as possible from the conditions of the Wet inburgering 2021.
requests the government to do everything possible so that these integration participants also benefit as much as possible from the conditions of the Wet inburgering 2021
verzoekt de regering er alles aan te doen om ook deze inburgeraars zo veel mogelijk te laten profiteren van de voorwaarden van de Wet inburgering 2021
Motie van de leden Boulakjar en Belhaj over afdwingbare regels in de aanpak van discriminatie bij woningverhuur
Asks the government to make enforceable rules against discrimination in rental housing and anchor them in the Wet goed verhuurderschap.
requests the government to make enforceable rules in tackling discrimination in rental housing
verzoekt de regering afdwingbare regels te maken in de aanpak van discriminatie bij woningverhuur
Motie van het lid Van Wijngaarden c.s. over een eigen aanstellingsmandaat voor het Defensie Cyber Commando
Asks the government to give the Defence Cyber Command its own appointment mandate after the HR transition, so it can appoint and promote military personnel like the operational commands.
requests the government to give the Defence Cyber Command its own appointment mandate after completion of the HR transition
verzoekt de regering het Defensie Cyber Commando na afronding van de hr-transitie een eigen aanstellingsmandaat te geven
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over kaders voor de inzet van lokale medewerkers bij toekomstige militaire missies en op Nederlandse ambassades en consulaten
Asks the government to draw up frameworks on the use of local staff in future military missions and at Dutch embassies, setting out the state's responsibilities towards them.
requests the government to draw up frameworks on the deployment of local staff
verzoekt de regering kaders op te stellen omtrent de inzet van lokale medewerkers
Motie van het lid Boswijk c.s. over het ontwikkelen van een strategie voor bescherming van de cruciale infrastructuur in de Noordzee
Asks the government to develop, with NATO and North Sea states, a strategy to protect critical North Sea infrastructure and report before summer 2022.
requests the government to examine the possibilities to jointly with NATO develop a strategy for protecting critical infrastructure in the North Sea
verzoekt de regering te kijken naar de mogelijkheden om gezamenlijk met de NAVO
Motie van het lid Boswijk c.s. over het handhaven van het verbod op militaire uniformen en het Rode Kruis-embleem bij demonstraties
Asks the government to enforce more strictly the ban on civilians wearing military uniforms and using the Red Cross emblem at demonstrations.
requests the government to enforce the abovementioned statutory articles and the ban more strictly
verzoekt de regering strenger te handhaven op de bovengenoemde wetsartikelen en het verbod
Motie van de leden Belhaj en Boswijk over tijdens besloten debatten beschikken over vertrouwelijke stukken
Asks the government to let MPs access confidential documents normally held at the Central Information Point during closed debates, to strengthen parliamentary control.
requests the government to make it possible for MPs to have access during closed debates to the confidential documents normally available at the Central Information Point
verzoekt de regering, het voor Kamerleden mogelijk te maken om tijdens besloten debatten te kunnen beschikken over de vertrouwelijke stukken
Motie van het lid Piri c.s. over voor einde Nederlandse aanwezigheid ervoor zorgen dat de Afghaanse tolken en hun gezinnen in Nederland zijn
Asks the government to actively bring all Afghan interpreters and their families to the Netherlands before the Dutch mission ends, including evacuation planning.
requests the government to use all possibilities before the end of Dutch presence to ensure the Afghan interpreters and their families are in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, om voor het einde van de Nederlandse aanwezigheid alle mogelijkheden te benutten om ervoor te zorgen dat de Afghaanse tolken en hun gezinnen in Nederland zijn
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over prioriteit voor de werving van personeel om de materiële gereedheid te verbeteren
Asks the government to prioritise using the defence budget to recruit the personnel needed to significantly improve material readiness.
requests the government, using Defence budget funds, to prioritise doing everything necessary to recruit the personnel needed
verzoekt de regering, om met de middelen uit de Defensiebegroting met prioriteit alles te doen wat nodig is om het personeel te verwerven
Motie van het lid Belhaj over de Nederlandse focus in het strategisch kompas van de EU
Asks the government to specify which threats the Netherlands should focus on within the EU strategic compass, and inform the Chamber.
to inform the Chamber about developments and the Dutch position for the upcoming strategic dialogue
de Kamer te informeren over de ontwikkelingen en de Nederlandse inzet voor de aankomende strategische dialoog
Motie van het lid Kerstens c.s. over een masterplan om het personeelstekort bij Defensie tegen te gaan
Asks the government to present a masterplan to the House by Q1 2021 showing the growth path, actions and funding to address staff shortages at Defence.
requests the government to send such a plan to the House in Q1 2021
verzoekt de regering, in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 een dergelijk plan aan de Kamer te doen toekomen
Motie van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Belhaj over mogelijke routes van specialisatie van Defensie binnen haar internationale partnerschappen
Motion asking the government to draw up scenarios for possible routes of Defence specialisation within its international partnerships and submit them to the House.
asks the government to draw up scenarios for possible routes of Defence specialisation within its international partnerships and submit them to the House
verzoekt de regering, scenario's op te stellen voor mogelijke routes van specialisatie van Defensie binnen haar internationale partnerschappen, en deze scenario's voor te leggen aan de Kamer
Motie van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen c.s. over marineschepen vernoemen naar vrouwen
Asks the government to convey to Defence that at least two new navy ships, including frigates, should be named after women significant to Dutch freedom.
at least two of the newly acquired navy ships, including frigates, are named after women of great significance to Dutch freedom
ten minste twee van de nieuw te verwerven marineschepen, waaronder fregatten, naar vrouwen met een grote betekenis voor de Nederlandse vrijheid worden vernoemd
Motie van het lid Kerstens c.s. over de aanbevelingen van de Veteranenombudsman over de wijze van klachtafhandeling
Asks the government to ensure clear improvements in complaint handling by Defence, as recommended repeatedly by the Veterans Ombudsman, shown in the next Complaints Monitor.
ensure that with respect to the recommendations repeatedly made by the Veterans Ombudsman, clear improvements are visible in the next Complaints Monitor

ervoor zorg te dragen dat ten aanzien van de inmiddels herhaaldelijk door de Veteranenombudsman in dezen gedane aanbevelingen, in zijn eerstvolgende Klachtenmonitor duidelijke verbeteringen te zien zijn
Motie van het lid Belhaj over de uitkomst van de blootstellingssimulatie evenwichtig laten meewegen in het ontwerp van de SMART-L-radar
Asks the government to commission a exposure simulation for a higher SMART-L radar and weigh its outcome in the final design in Herwijnen.
requests the government to have an exposure simulation carried out in which the SMART-L radar is raised compared to the current model
verzoekt de regering, een blootstellingssimulatie te laten uitvoeren waarbij de SMART-L-radar verhoogd wordt ten opzichte van het huidige model
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over een commissie voor advies over recht op een uitkering voor wie een aandoening hebben die niet op de ziektelijst staat
Asks the government to set up an external commission to advise on an impact analysis of paying benefits to all workers possibly exposed to chromium-6, not only those with a listed illness.
requests the government to set up an external commission that examines the following and drafts advice on it
verzoekt de regering, om een externe commissie in te stellen die het volgende onderzoekt en hierover een advies opstelt
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over behoud van het Mariniersmuseum in Rotterdam
Asks the government to work to keep the Marine Museum in Rotterdam and inform the House of the outcome of the merger study by 15 January 2021.
asks the government to work to preserve the Marine Museum in Rotterdam
verzoekt de regering, om zich in te zetten voor behoud van het Mariniersmuseum in Rotterdam
Motie van de leden Van den Hul en Belhaj over een aanvullende routekaart voor de culturele sector
Asks cabinet to engage with cultural sector initiators on how their supplementary roadmap for reopening venues fits the current roadmap.
requests the cabinet to engage with the initiators on how the proposals of this supplementary roadmap of the cultural sector can connect to the current roadmap
verzoekt het kabinet, in gesprek te gaan met de initiatiefnemers over hoe de voorstellen van deze aanvullende routekaart van de culturele sector aan kunnen sluiten op de huidige routekaart
Motie van het lid Paternotte c.s. over in kaart brengen welk deel van de kunstcollectie van de koninklijke familie privé-eigendom is
Asks the government, with the royal family and the Commissie Collectie Nederland, to explore how to map which parts of the royal art collection are private property versus state property.
requests the government, in consultation with the royal family and the Commissie Collectie Nederland, to explore how this can be mapped
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de koninklijke familie en de Commissie Collectie Nederland te verkennen hoe dit in kaart gebracht kan worden
Motie van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Belhaj over de toekomst van de collectie van Muziekweb veiligstellen
Asks the government to investigate how to secure the Muziekweb music collection and access to it, and to report to the House by 1 February 2021.
to investigate what is needed to secure the future of the Muziekweb collection and access to it
te onderzoeken wat er nodig is om de toekomst van de collectie van Muziekweb en de toegang ertoe veilig te stellen
Motie van het lid Van den Berge c.s. over concrete afspraken over het afdragen van leenrechtvergoedingen
Asks the government to ensure rightholders are involved in the talks on library-on-school lending remuneration, so that concrete payment agreements apply from 1 January 2021.
requests the government to ensure that rightholders are involved in the talks
verzoekt de regering, erop toe te zien dat rechthebbenden worden betrokken in de gesprekken
Motie van het lid Bosman c.s. over een onderzoek hoe de vervroegde-uittredingsregeling van militairen past in de financiële wet- en regelgeving
Asks the government to commission an independent study into how the early-exit scheme for military personnel fits financial law and regulation.
requests the government to have an investigation carried out by an independent party
verzoekt de regering, een onderzoek uit te laten voeren door een onafhankelijke partij
Motie van het lid Asscher c.s. over steun voor ondernemers, werkenden en makers uit de creatieve sector
Asks the government to include entrepreneurs, workers and creators in the cultural and creative sector in the additional support for the sector.
requests the government to also include entrepreneurs, workers and makers from the creative and cultural sector in this
verzoekt de regering, hierin ook de ondernemers, werkenden en makers uit de creatieve en culturele sector mee te nemen
Motie van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over zorg dragen voor regionale spreiding bij behoud van culturele instellingen
Asks the government to ensure regional spread when allocating funds to preserve cultural institutions with vital regional importance.
asks the government, when elaborating the scheme, to ensure that regional distribution is guaranteed
verzoekt de regering bij de uitwerking van de regeling ervoor zorg te dragen dat regionale spreiding gewaarborgd is
Motie van de leden Asscher en Belhaj over ondersteuning van niet-gesubsidieerde instellingen
Asks the government to investigate how non-subsidised cultural institutions and makers can get more support during the coronavirus crisis.
requests the government to investigate how more support can be provided to non-subsidised institutions and organisations
verzoekt de regering, om te onderzoeken hoe niet-gesubsidieerde instellingen en organisaties meer ondersteuning kan worden geboden
Motie van het lid Van den Berge c.s. over door de crisis heen helpen van creatieve makers in de culturele sector
Asks the government to do everything possible to help creative workers in the culture sector, including freelancers, through the corona crisis.
requests the government to do everything possible to help creative makers in the cultural sector
verzoekt de regering alles in het werk te stellen om creatieve makers in de culturele sector
Amendement van het lid Voordewind c.s. t.v.v. nr. 9 over het opsplitsen van defensiematerieel in afzonderlijke begrotingsartikelen
Splits the defence equipment fund into separate budget articles so parliament can formally authorise budgets for maritime, land, air and general equipment.
This split of this article can further strengthen the budgetary right.
Deze opsplitsing van dit artikel kan het budgetrecht verder versterken.
Amendement van het lid Voordewind c.s. over het opsplitsen van defensiematerieel in afzonderlijke begrotingsartikelen
Requires that defence materiel spending be shown separately for maritime, land, air and defence-wide materiel, so parliament can authorise each budget line.
In any case it is made transparent which commitments, expenditures and receipts are separately charged to maritime, land, air and defence-wide materiel.

Daarbij wordt in ieder geval inzichtelijk gemaakt welke verplichtingen, uitgaven en ontvangsten afzonderlijk ten laste komen van maritiem materieel, landmaterieel, luchtmaterieel, en defensiebreed materieel.
Motie van het lid Asscher c.s. over één dag per maand gratis openstellen van rijksmusea
Asks the government to explore whether opening state museums free of charge one day per month would attract new visitors.
requests the government to explore whether opening national museums free one day per month contributes
verzoekt de regering, te verkennen of het één dag per maand gratis openstellen van rijksmusea bijdraagt
Motie van het lid Asscher c.s. over opnemen van een percentage voor recent geproduceerde Nederlandse of Friestalige producties
Asks the government to include a 10% quota for recently produced Dutch or Frisian-language productions in the implementation of the EU audiovisual media directive.
to explicitly include, when implementing the European directive, a 10% share of recently produced Dutch or Frisian-language productions
om bij de implementatie van de Europese richtlijn expliciet ook een percentage van 10% recent geproduceerde Nederlandse of Friestalige producties op te nemen
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over onder de aandacht brengen van de Leidraad tariefafspraken zzp'ers
Asks the government to promote the ACM guideline on rate agreements for self-employed workers in the arts and culture sector and support its use.
requests the government, possibly with the ACM and the Labour Market Agenda steering group, to draw attention to the guideline on rate agreements for self-employed workers
verzoekt de regering, eventueel in samenwerking met de ACM en de Regiegroep Arbeidsmarktagenda, de Leidraad tariefafspraken zzp'ers onder de aandacht te brengen
Motie van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet c.s. over een structurele ondersteuning van amateurkunstverenigingen
Asks the government to study how structural support for amateur arts associations can be strengthened and report to the Chamber before summer 2020.
to investigate how structural support for amateur arts associations can be strengthened
te onderzoeken hoe de structurele ondersteuning van amateurkunstverenigingen kan worden versterkt
Motie van de leden Kwint en Belhaj over verlichten van de verantwoordingsdruk voor makers en instellingen
Asks the government to reduce accountability burdens for cultural makers and institutions by harmonising application and reporting requirements across governments.
requests the government to reduce the accountability pressure on makers and institutions
verzoekt de regering, de verantwoordingsdruk voor makers en instellingen te verlichten
Motie van de leden Ellemeet en Belhaj over een verkenning van de staat van de publieke collecties
Motion asks the government to explore the condition of public art collections outside the national collection, in consultation with owners, and inform the House.
requests the government to explore the state of these public collections, in consultation with their owners
verzoekt de regering, de staat van deze publieke collecties, in samenspraak met hun eigenaren, te verkennen
Motie van het lid Ellemeet c.s. over de gevolgen van de verschuiving van het budget van het Fonds Podiumkunsten naar de BIS
Motion asking the government to report to the House on how many institutions are affected by shifting Fonds Podiumkunsten budget to the BIS and the financial impact.
requests the government, in consultation with the Fonds Podiumkunsten, to make clear how many institutions are involved and what the financial impact is, and to inform the House by this spring

verzoekt de regering, in overleg met het Fonds Podiumkunsten inzichtelijk te maken om hoeveel instellingen het gaat en welk financieel beslag dit heeft, en de Kamer hier uiterlijk dit voorjaar over te informeren
Motie van de leden Belhaj en Voordewind over het beschermingsbeleid voor tolken
Asks the government to classify interpreters who served the Dutch armed forces in Afghanistan as a systematically persecuted group and to write protection into their contracts.
requests the government to align protection policy for interpreters with the EASO Country Guidance on Afghanistan
verzoekt de regering, het beschermingsbeleid voor tolken in lijn te brengen met de EASO Country Guidance over Afghanistan
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over de mogelijkheid om in twee veteranenontmoetingscentra hulpverlening te bieden
Asks the government to investigate offering professional social and psychological help at two veterans' meeting centres and report back in a year.
to investigate whether it is possible to offer professional help (social and psychological) at two veterans' meeting centres
te onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om in twee veteranenontmoetingscentra professionele hulpverlening (sociaal en psychologisch) te bieden
Motie van het lid Belhaj over de voor- en nadelen van een alternatieve financiering van een nog te starten materieelproject
Asks the government to draft a new concept for a planned materiel project based on alternative financing and inform the House of pros and cons compared with the current financing method.
and to inform the House about the pros and cons in relation to the current financing method
en de Kamer te informeren over de voor- en nadelen in relatie tot de huidige financieringswerkwijze
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over na aanname van de Rijkswet per direct voorlichting starten
Asks the government to start information campaigns for Dutch nationals in the UK immediately after the Brexit nationality law takes effect.
ensure that after adoption of the Brexit consequences law, information about this change can start immediately for Dutch nationals in the UK
zorg te dragen dat na aanname van de Rijkswet inperking gevolgen Brexit in beide Kamers per direct de voorlichting over deze wetswijziging voor Nederlanders in het VK gestart kan worden
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over in gesprek gaan met vertegenwoordigers van Britten in Nederland
Asks the government to consult representatives of British nationals in the Netherlands on Brexit-related arrangements and report to the House.
requests the government to enter into discussion with these representatives about their wishes
verzoekt de regering, met deze vertegenwoordigers in gesprek te gaan over hun wensen
Motie van het lid Belhaj over de voortgang van de implementatie van het DAP 1325
Asks the government to inform the House about the evaluation of the steering committee and on progress implementing the Defence Action Plan on UNSCR 1325 and allied practices.
requests the government, in line with the commitment in the Defence Action Plan 1325, to inform the House about the evaluation of the steering committee
verzoekt de regering, conform de toezegging in het Defensie Actieplan 1325 (DAP 1325), de Kamer te informeren over de evaluatie van de regiecommissie
Motie van het lid Belhaj over het actief stoppen met het werken met chroom-6-houdende verf
Asks the Ministry of Defence to actively stop working with chromium-6 paint as soon as possible and speed up replacement.
requests the government, and specifically the Ministry of Defence, to actively stop working with chromium-6 paint as soon as possible.
verzoekt de regering, en specifiek het Ministerie van Defensie, om zo spoedig mogelijk actief te stoppen met het werken met chroom-6-houdende verf
Motie van het lid Belhaj over onderzoek naar veiligheidsmanagement betreffende burnpits
Asks the government to have the Defence Safety Inspectorate (IVD) investigate safety management regarding burn pits and advise on preventing soldiers' exposure.
requests the government to have the IVD conduct research into safety management concerning burn pits
verzoekt de regering, de IVD onderzoek te laten doen naar veiligheidsmanagement betreffende burnpits
Motie van het lid Belhaj over het financieel-economische aspect niet in overweging nemen
Asks the Ministry of Defence to exclude financial-economic considerations when deciding whether replacing chromium-6 paint is feasible.
not to take into account the financial-economic aspect, within the budgetary frameworks of Defence
het financieel-economische aspect, binnen de budgettaire kaders van Defensie, niet in overweging te nemen
Motie van het lid Belhaj over maatregelen om gezondheidsschade door uitstootgassen van burnpits te voorkomen
Asks the government to take all possible measures to prevent military personnel's exposure to and health harm from burn pit emissions.
requests the government to take all possible measures to prevent as far as possible exposure to and health damage from burn pit emissions
verzoekt de regering, alle mogelijke maatregelen te treffen om blootstelling aan en gezondheidsschade veroorzaakt door uitstootgassen van burnpits zo veel als mogelijk te voorkomen
Motie van het lid Belhaj over een evaluatie na één jaar van MID, COID en IVD
Asks the government to evaluate the Defence integrity reporting point, integrity organisation and inspectorate after one year, involving staff and submitting the evaluation design to parliament.
after one year to evaluate the functioning of the IVD, the MID and the COID
na één jaar het functioneren van de IVD, het MID en de COID te evalueren
Motie van het lid Belhaj over het waarborgen van onafhankelijkheid van onderzoeken door IVD en COID

Asks the government to ensure independence and objectivity of investigations by the defence integrity bodies and the defence safety inspectorate by excluding persons involved in the matters under review.
requests the government, in investigations and complaint handling by the MID, COID and Defence Safety Inspectorate, to guarantee independence and objectivity
verzoekt de regering, bij onderzoeken naar en bij de afhandeling van klachten door het MID, de COID en de Inspectie Veiligheid Defensie, de onafhankelijkheid en objectiviteit te waarborgen
Motie van het lid Belhaj over het opnieuw laten bekijken van zaken door het multidisciplinaire team

Motion asking the government to let persons with pending Defence abuse cases, including those already settled by court ruling or settlement, have their cases reviewed afresh by the multidisciplinary team.
offer the possibility to have cases by the multidisciplinary team, including cases already legally settled, reviewed with a fresh look
de mogelijkheid te bieden om zaken door het multidisciplinaire team ook zaken die reeds in rechte vaststaan ... met een frisse blik te laten bekijken
Motie van het lid Belhaj over het Marine Etablissement Amsterdam
Asks the government to inform the House first about all financial implications and the need for reconsidering the Marine Etablissement Amsterdam before taking any steps.
instructs the government to first inform the House of all financial implications and the usefulness and necessity
draagt de regering op de Tweede Kamer eerst te informeren over alle financiële implicaties en nut en noodzaak
Motie van het lid Belhaj over diversiteits- en inclusiviteitsmiddelen
Asks the government to show separately in future budgets and annual reports the funds for Defence diversity networks, which were hidden under another budget article.
requests the government to make transparent in the next budget and annual report what the financial resources are
verzoekt de regering om, in de volgende begroting en jaarverslag inzichtelijk te maken wat de financiële middelen zijn
Motie van het lid Bruins Slot c.s. over wifi van thuiskwaliteit voor Defensie
Asks the government to provide good-quality home-type wifi for all barracks accommodation within Defence and to present a plan to the House.
requests the government to provide good-quality wireless broadband internet, home wifi, for all accommodation within Defence
verzoekt de regering, te voorzien in draadloos breedbandinternet van goede kwaliteit, thuiswifi, voor alle legering binnen Defensie
Motie van de leden Diks en Belhaj over een inspraaktraject in de aanloop naar de herijking van de Defensievisie
Motion asking the government to start a public consultation process before the Defence Vision is revised in 2020, involving the Chamber, personnel and society.
requests the government, leading up to the 2020 revision of the Defence Vision, to start a consultation process to involve the Chamber, defence personnel and society
verzoekt de regering, in aanloop naar de herijking van de Defensievisie in 2020 een inspraaktraject in te zetten om de Kamer, Defensiepersoneel en de samenleving te betrekken
Motie van de leden Belhaj en Bosman over een gezamenlijke Europese militaire trainingsfaciliteit
Asks the government to explore a PESCO project for a shared European urban warfare training facility for special forces.
requests the government to explore in the short term the possibilities for a PESCO project initiative
verzoekt de regering, op korte termijn de mogelijkheden te verkennen voor het initiatief van een PESCO-project
Motie van het lid Bruins Slot c.s. over een blijk van waardering voor het Defensiepersoneel
Asks the government, if no collective labour agreement for defence staff is reached this year, to bring a supplementary proposal before the new year showing appreciation for defence personnel.
requests the government, if a working conditions agreement is not reached this year, to come with an additional proposal before the new year
verzoekt de regering, indien het dit jaar niet tot een arbeidsvoorwaardenakkoord komt, nog voor de jaarwisseling met een aanvullend voorstel te komen
Motie van het lid Belhaj over kwantificering van het programma Behoud en Werving
Asks the government to quantify the Behoud en Werving personnel programme with measurable goals, timelines and funding, and to report progress in the personnel report.
requests the government to quantify the Behoud en Werving programme and related measures with concrete measurable targets
verzoekt de regering, om het programma Behoud en Werving en de daarbij behorende aanvullende maatregelen te kwantificeren met concreet meetbare doelstellingen
Motie van het lid Belhaj over de planning van de verwerving van gevechtskleding en uitrusting

Asks the government to report to the Chamber on the annual planning and progress of centrally procured combat clothing and equipment, and on how the defence intervention desk handles problems with clothing and equipment.
requests the government to report to the Chamber on the (annual) planning and implementation progress of centrally procured combat clothing and equipment for soldiers
verzoekt de regering, om over de (jaarlijkse) planning en de uitvoeringsvoortgang van de centraal te verwerven gevechtskleding en uitrusting van militairen aan de Kamer te rapporteren
Motie van het lid Belhaj over mogelijke interne disciplinaire maatregelen
Asks the government, after the criminal investigation, to examine whether internal disciplinary measures can be taken against officials for negligent or culpable conduct.
to examine the possibility of taking (additional) internal disciplinary measures
onderzoek te doen naar de mogelijkheid om tot (aanvullende) interne disciplinaire maatregelen over te gaan
Motie van het lid Belhaj over actief informeren van de Kamer bij een gewijzigd instellingsbesluit
Asks the government to always actively inform the Chamber when an establishment decision for a commission changes its task in whole or part.
requests the government to actively inform the Chamber at all times
verzoekt de regering, te allen tijde de Kamer actief te informeren
Motie van het lid Belhaj over een jaarverslag van de inspecteur-generaal Veiligheid
Asks that the inspector-general for Security inform the House every year through an annual report.
requests the government to have the inspector-general for Security inform the House annually through an annual report
verzoekt de regering, de inspecteur-generaal Veiligheid de Kamer jaarlijks te laten informeren middels een jaarverslag
Motie van het lid Bruins Slot c.s. over investeren in cyber
Asks the government to invest in cyber as a full fifth military domain and expand Defence's role in protecting against digital threats alongside civilian partners.
requests the government to invest in cyber as a full fifth military domain
verzoekt de regering, te investeren in cyber als volwaardig vijfde militaire domein
Motie van het lid Belhaj c.s. over het groeipad voor uitgaven aan innovatie
Asks the government to inform the House on the growth path for defence R&D and innovation spending when presenting the Defence white paper and supplementary budget.
requests the government to inform the House about the growth path for spending on research and development and innovation

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Education and of Justice about reports that diversity officers in higher education were intimidated and threatened online, and what the government would do to strengthen their position. The minister condemned the doxing and threats, pointed to a pending bill criminalising doxing and a forthcoming approach to online discrimination, but gave only general answers on strengthening diversity officers' position, deferring responsibility for staff safety to institutional boards.
The cabinet will develop an approach in 2023 to intensify cabinet policy against online discrimination, racism and hate speech.
Het kabinet zal in 2023 een aanpak ontwikkelen voor een intensivering van het kabinetsbeleid voor het tegengaan van online discriminatie, racisme en hate speech.

MPs Sahla, Belhaj and Kuzu asked ministers about a NRC article saying racism pushes care workers out of elderly care, and about the scale of discrimination, its effect on health and sickness absence, and what government and care providers are doing. The ministers answered that discrimination is recognised but insufficiently addressed by employers, cited survey data, described existing Arbo duties and support tools, and announced a national study in 2023 and a progress letter in autumn 2023.
The Ministry of VWS intends to start a nationwide study in 2023 into discrimination and equal opportunities in care, welfare and sport.
Het Ministerie van VWS wil in 2023 een landelijk onderzoek starten naar discriminatie en gelijk kansen in de zorg, welzijn en sport.

I aim to share this amendment note with your House shortly (before the end of the year), so that the treatment of this bill can be continued.

Zoals ik uw Kamer heb bericht in het eerste Halfjaarbericht politie 2021zal er in 2022 nader onderzoek plaatsvinden naar het gebruik van de Proco-functionaliteit

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de aanbestedingsprocedure van de 515 terreinwagens voor de luchtmobiele brigade bij Mercedes-Benz in het programma Defensiebrede Vervanging Operationele Wielvoertuigen (DVOW)

MP Belhaj asked the Defence Minister about the procurement of 515 all-terrain vehicles for the air assault brigade, won by Mercedes-Benz, including user involvement, the selection process, ministry cooperation, delivery delays and DMO staffing. The minister answered in detail on the procedure, the award criteria and staffing, but declined to say whether delivery can be guaranteed and deferred the delivery-date question to a separate letter.

Defence is currently investigating whether the procurement can be continued and how the air assault brigade's needs can be met as quickly as possible. You will be informed separately about this in more detail.

Momenteel onderzoekt Defensie of de aanbesteding kan worden vervolgd en hoe op zo kort mogelijke termijn in de behoefte van de Luchtmobiele Brigade kan worden voorzien. U wordt hierover separaat nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Nederlandse militairen oefenen zonder vergunningen op voormalige plantage in Curaçao’

MP Belhaj asked the Defence Minister whether the military knowingly built and trained at Dovale on Curaçao without the required building permit, why permit applications were delayed, and whether training continues. The Minister answers that training rests on long-standing use and private agreements, the permit was only applied for in March 2021 after a Carmabi study, and training continues while a permit process runs with Curaçao's authorities.
In March 2021 the application for the building permit for the Dovale training camp and the first bivouac location (A) was officially and fully submitted to the Curaçao government.
In maart 2021 is de aanvraag voor de aanlegvergunning voor oefenkamp Dovale en de eerste bivaklocatie (A) officieel en volledig ingediend bij de Curaçaose overheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Belhaj over Noodsteun Haïti

MPs Hammelburg and Belhaj asked the ministers for Foreign Trade and Development and for Defence about Dutch emergency aid for the Haiti earthquake, including EU coordination, UN and Red Cross support, funding from the crisis reserve, technical expertise such as USAR and water experts, and military deployment. The minister answered that Nederland was asked for experts and a naval ship (Zr.Ms. Holland) was deployed, the Red Cross would release EUR 400,000, and the Dutch USAR and water-expert teams were not requested.
Yes, in that context it is good to see that aid operations are being set up from various quarters.
Ja, in dat verband is het goed te zien dat er vanuit verschillende hoeken hulpoperaties worden opgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Bromet, Ceder, Kuzu en Dassen over Afghaanse tolken

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how the government would support Afghan interpreters and their families to evacuate as security collapsed, including whether passport requirements would be waived and a charter flight arranged. The government said it is doing everything possible to bring the group to safety, explained that Afghan authorities and airlines required passports and that airport access depends on verifiable identity, and promised a further letter on the consequences of recent developments.
The cabinet will shortly send a further letter to address the consequences of the recent developments.
Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een nadere brief sturen om in te gaan op de consequenties van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Bromet, Ceder en Kuzu over het beschermen van Afghanen die werkzaam waren voor Nederland tijdens de Afghanistanmissies

MPs from six parties asked the cabinet why it is not doing more to quickly bring Afghan interpreters and other former local staff who worked for Dutch missions to safety, including questions on the asylum process, document problems, non-interpreter staff, and a deportation moratorium. The ministers answered that additional staff were deployed, interpreters' remaining requirements were dropped, about 43 interpreters had arrived since June, non-interpreters are assessed individually and generously, and the moratorium's extension will be decided later.
The cabinet is taking all steps within its own power to bring the interpreters and their families to the Netherlands as quickly as possible.
Het kabinet onderneemt alle stappen die binnen het eigen vermogen liggen om de tolken en hun gezinnen op een zo kort mogelijke termijn naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Kuzu over ‘De Nederlandse militairen zijn weg uit Afghanistan, maar hun tolken lopen gevaar’

MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about Afghan interpreters and guards who worked for the Dutch mission still awaiting admission, including passport delays, EUPOL interpreters and exclusion of guards. The government gave detailed figures, explained passport and identity-verification obstacles, said it will consider guards case by case, and answered that each question would be addressed separately.
The cabinet makes maximum efforts to do what is possible if an applicant does not have a passport.
Het kabinet zet zich maximaal in om te doen wat mogelijk is indien een aanvrager niet over een paspoort beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Jules de Kom: “Eerherstel opa Anton de Kom begint met intrekken vervolging”

Rep. Belhaj asked why Anton de Kom, dead for 76 years, has not been formally exonerated and whether the government will act on the Van Ojik motion calling for a gesture of recognition. The government answers that criminal liability lapsed at his death, that recognition has been given in various ways, and that a gesture of rehabilitation is being developed with the family under the motion.
This will be worked on, partly within the framework of implementing the motion, in consultation with the family.
Daar zal, mede in het kader van de uitvoering van de motie, aan worden gewerkt in samenspraak met de familie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over niet kwijtschelding lening t.b.v. inburgering bij geringe termijnoverschrijding van 23 juni jl.

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why a loan for civic integration was not waived when an applicant missed the deadline by a small margin, and whether the court ruling against the government would be followed. The minister defended the current all-or-nothing rule, accepted the ruling without appeal, promised a review of the regulation and said DUO would consider similar cases in future.
I accept the ruling and will not lodge an appeal.
Ik leg me neer bij de uitspraak en stel geen hoger beroep in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het gebruik van explosieve wapens in dichtbevolkte gebieden

An MP asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about the high civilian share of casualties from explosive weapons in populated areas, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The government answers that it deplores civilian harm, stresses better compliance with international humanitarian law and transparency, and says it will keep the Chamber informed on the EWIPA political declaration negotiations, while declining to commit to stronger national measures.
Yes. Once the negotiations have concluded, the cabinet will inform the Chamber of the outcome and provide further explanation of the Dutch position.
Ja. Op het moment dat de onderhandelingen geconcludeerd zijn, zal het kabinet de Kamer op de hoogte brengen van de uitkomst en nadere toelichting geven op de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'Ook in Nederland trekt legergroen rechts-extremisten aan'

An MP from D66 asks the Defence Minister about a Trouw report on far-right extremists being drawn to the military, citing MIVD findings and a 2019 commitment to report on far-right extremism in the armed forces. The minister confirms the commitment and says the MIVD sees far-right youth finding military work attractive but that this does not mean Defence is an attractive employer for extremists; she declines to share figures on ongoing investigations, describes existing vetting and personnel measures, and declines to comment on contact with German counterparts.
The MIVD does not share figures on ongoing investigations into far-right extremism, because that could harm the investigation.
De MIVD deelt geen cijfers over lopende onderzoeken naar rechts-extremisme, omdat dat het onderzoek kan schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Belhaj en Piri over het uit de vaart nemen van een marineschip door een ernstig tekort aan personeel

MPs asked the State Secretary why technical staff shortages forced the navy to take Johan de Wit and Van Speijk out of service, and how Defence plans to create specialist career paths to retain personnel. The government attributes the decommissioning to staff shortages and to redeploying crews to other ships, and sets out HR transition measures including specialist career paths that still need union agreement.
The temporary removal from service of Johan de Wit and Van Speijk is driven by two causes.
Het tijdelijk uit de vaart halen van Zr. Ms. Johan de Wit (JWIT) en Zr. Ms. Van Speijk (VSPK) wordt door twee oorzaken ingegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de veteranenstatus van militairen die in verschillende hoedanigheid gediend hebben in de Nederlandse krijgsmacht

An MP asked the Defence Minister why military personnel who served in the Suriname troop mission, the Cold War, and humanitarian missions cannot obtain veteran status, whether this causes a sense of disregard, what alternative recognition exists, and whether a medal or decoration can be provided. The minister answered that these groups fall outside the Veterans Act definition, that existing recognition (reunion facilities, existing medals) is adequate, and that no new decoration is planned, while stating respect for their service.
The military personnel who served in the Suriname Troop Force (TRIS) were part of the Royal Netherlands Army, stationed in Paramaribo.
De militairen die hebben gediend in de Troepenmacht Suriname (TRIS) maakten onderdeel uit van de Koninklijke Landmacht, met een plaatsing in Paramaribo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat mariniers met schamele uitrusting naar Irak vertrokken

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that marines were deployed to Iraq with inadequate equipment, including missing radios and heavy machine guns, and whether Defence's airlift capacity is sufficient. The minister denied equipment was inadequate, attributed a delay in some items to an administrative error, explained the planning and loan arrangements for radios, and acknowledged airlift capacity still falls short of defence needs, with a new tactical transport fleet due from 2026.
The delayed equipment has meanwhile arrived in the deployment area.
Het vertraagde materieel is inmiddels in het inzetgebied gearriveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Afghaanse tolken in levensgevaar komen als de coalitietroepen van de resolute support missie vertrekken uit Afghanistan

Two D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about risks to Afghan interpreters who worked for Dutch forces as coalition troops leave Afghanistan, and about implementation of the Belhaj motion on relocating them. The government answered that over 60 interpreters with families have already come to the Netherlands, that the Afghan authorities are responsible for citizens' safety, and that interpreters meeting the conditions will be processed for asylum, with no specific numbers at risk disclosed.
On the numbers of interpreters who may be at risk, names and dates, we make no statements in the security interest of the interpreters.
Over aantallen tolken die mogelijk risico lopen, namen en data doen we uit veiligheidsbelang van de tolken geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Karabulut over “LIMC, JISTARC en andere inlichtingenwerkzaamheden van de Krijgsmacht”

MPs Belhaj and Karabulut asked the Defence Minister about the experimental Land Information Manoeuvre Centre (LIMC), its data gathering on domestic activist groups, its links to JISTARC and whether it had a legal mandate. The state secretary answered that LIMC lacked a mandate for activities outside the armed forces' own tasks, that the activities were halted in November 2020, that data is being archived or destroyed under archive rules, and that the legal framework was being reinforced.
Without a mandate it is not permitted to approach Dutch citizens.
Zonder mandaat is het niet toegestaan Nederlandse burgers te benaderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Belhaj over eventuele registratie homoseksualiteit bij Defensie

MPs Bergkamp and Belhaj asked about the treatment of LGBTI personnel in the Dutch armed forces, including past S5 unfitness markings for homosexuality and whether restitution is possible. The Secretary of State answered that no current cases of discharge or refusal for sexual orientation have surfaced, that the S5 marking was used only at pre-1974 conscription screening, and that individual cases will be reviewed while awaiting ongoing historical research.
I am always willing to look at individual cases, however there is so far no reason to conduct large-scale research into this.
Ik ben altijd bereid te kijken naar individuele gevallen, echter er blijkt vooralsnog geen aanleiding te zijn om hier grootschalig onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over het bericht 'Situation Report EEPA HORN No. 50' van 9 januari en 'Situation Report HORN No. 81' van 11 februari

MPs Sjoerdsma and Belhaj asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports on the Tigray conflict, including the killing of an aid worker, destruction of refugee camps, alleged Eritrean involvement and massacres, plus the response of the government, EU and UN. The minister answered in substance, noting Ethiopia's commitments to humanitarian access and independent investigation, Dutch calls for Eritrean withdrawal, and that details on some incidents could not be verified or discussed for confidentiality reasons.
On the use of this regime in specific situations I cannot make public statements for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de inzet van dit regime in specifieke situaties kan ik omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid geen openbare uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'Nederlandse militair gewond bij schietoefening op kamp in Afghanistan'

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a Dutch soldier injured during a shooting exercise in Afghanistan, including the cause, the soldier's condition, prior similar incidents and lessons learned. The minister said a Marechaussee investigation is ongoing so causes are unclear, the soldier is recovering, about 1,300 injury reports were logged from 2013 to 2020, and Defence has introduced firearms safety policy with a stuurgroep, training and a planned knowledge centre.
The Royal Military Police is currently conducting an investigation into the incident.
De Koninklijke Marechaussee voert momenteel een onderzoek uit naar het incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Leger Ethiopië neemt hoofdstad van Tigray in'

MPs Belhaj and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about the armed conflict in Tigray, Ethiopia, including casualty figures, alleged civilian massacres, humanitarian needs, refugee flows to Sudan, international calls for a ceasefire, and Dutch response. The minister answered that information is unreliable due to restricted access, condemned the reported violence, called for a ceasefire and access for aid workers and journalists, and described Dutch humanitarian funding.
Because humanitarian workers, media and observers lack access to the area, the cabinet does not have reliable, independent information on casualties.
Vanwege het gebrek aan toegang voor humanitaire hulpverleners, media en waarnemers tot het gebied beschikt het kabinet niet over betrouwbare, onafhankelijke informatie over slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Australische militairen 39 burgers en gevangenen executeerden in Afghanistan

Two D66 MPs asked whether the ministers knew of reports that Australian soldiers executed 39 civilians and prisoners in Afghanistan, what the Dutch government knew and when, whether Dutch soldiers worked closely with Australian forces, and whether any war crimes investigation was conducted. The minister answered that the Australian inquiry shared no information beforehand, that Dutch soldiers were interviewed only in confidential interviews in 2018, that Dutch-Australian cooperation existed within Task Force Uruzgan, and that the Netherlands conducted no investigation into possible Australian war crimes.
The record of these confidential interviews was not made available to the cabinet or to the interviewed soldiers by the Australian inquiry commission.
Het verslag van deze vertrouwelijke interviews is niet door de Australische onderzoekscommissie aan het kabinet of aan de geïnterviewde militairen ter beschikking gesteld.
Antwoord op van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Hoe een kunstenaar carrière maakt onder aanhoudende beschuldigingen van aanranding en verkrachting’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a NRC report on an artist continuing his career despite repeated allegations of sexual assault and rape, and about reports of misconduct and racism in Dutch art institutions shared on an Instagram account and with the Mores complaints platform. The minister condemned boundary-crossing behaviour, said the artist's case is under criminal investigation, pointed to existing complaint and ombudsperson channels, promised talks with the Vereniging Hogescholen, and said no structural problem has been shown, though the sector should adopt a protocol.
It is important to report the boundary-crossing behaviour to the confidential counsellor or ombudsperson and, if necessary, to file a police report.
Het is belangrijk om bij de vertrouwenspersoon of ombudspersoon melding te maken van het grensoverschrijdende gedrag en zo nodig aangifte te doen bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Uitgaan is nu een avondje zitten’

An MP asked several ministers about illegal parties during COVID restrictions, enforcement numbers, the option of controlled reopening of venues, and support for the sector. The government answered that enforcement data cannot be split by party type, that nightclubs stay closed due to infection risk, that a ventilation pilot is being prepared, and that financial support schemes continue.
Unfortunately, a breakdown by illegal parties and festivals cannot be made.
Een uitsplitsing naar illegale feesten en festivals is helaas niet te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Van den Berge, Asscher en Kwint over het bericht ‘Culturele instellingen in chaos na coronamaatregelen

MPs asked the ministers why COVID-19 exemptions for cultural institutions differ between regions, why safety regions were unprepared, and whether a uniform rule set and RIVM-tested pilots are possible. The government answered that exemptions lapsed after the tougher measures of 13 October, that a uniform 30-visitor cap now applies and a routekaart improves predictability, and that a Fieldlab programme and RIVM advice will inform test events.
With these tougher measures, the possibility for the Safety Regions to grant exemptions has lapsed.
Met deze stevigere maatregelen is de mogelijkheid tot het verlenen van vrijstellingen door de Veiligheidsregio’s komen te vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten werken samen met omstreden techgigant Huawei’.

MPs asked why Huawei is partly excluded from critical 5G infrastructure in the Netherlands but not from university research cooperation with UvA and VU, and what framework governs cooperation with foreign-state-influenced companies. The government replied that universities are autonomous under the WHW and that the cooperation falls outside vital infrastructure, that authorities advised universities on risks, and that an investment screening and export-control framework is being developed, without committing to new binding rules on university cooperation.

Under their autonomy pursuant to the WHW, the universities themselves are responsible for deciding whether or not to enter a particular (international) research cooperation, within the frameworks of existing laws and regulations.

De universiteiten zijn vanuit hun autonomie op grond van de WHW zelf verantwoordelijk voor het besluit om – binnen de kaders van bestaande wet- en regelgeving – al dan niet een bepaalde (internationale) onderzoekssamenwerking aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, Belhaj en De Groot over munitiedumps in de Deltawateren en Noordzeekust

Three D66 MPs asked the government about the munitions dump in the Oosterschelde and North Sea sites, including the risks, monitoring, clean-up or capping costs, and whether a dedicated management fund exists. The government answered that research results will be sent to parliament in 2021, that monitoring shows no danger, that no clean-up or capping is planned under current assessments, and that only existing monitoring budgets are available.
The results will then be submitted to your House in 2021.
De resultaten worden dan in 2021 aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat Defensie gedragsbeïnvloedingsmethodes ontwikkelt voor moderne oorlogsvoering

An MP asks the Minister of Defence about reports that the Dutch armed forces develop behavioural influence methods (BDM) for modern warfare, including whether an ethical framework is needed, the risk of pulling civilians into conflict, comparisons with other countries, training, the purchase from a firm linked to Cambridge Analytica, and whether a public debate is needed. The Minister answers that existing legal and ethical frameworks apply, that civilians are not drawn into conflict unlawfully, that a debate is welcome, and that the method is currently not used abroad.
Yes. Since 2014 it has been government policy that departments, including Defence, invest in building behavioural science expertise to improve government policy.
Ja. Sinds 2014 is het kabinetsbeleid dat de departementen, waaronder Defensie investeren in het opbouwen van gedragswetenschappelijke expertise om het overheidsbeleid te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Rusland betaalde Afghaanse strijders om Amerikaanse militairen te doden’

MPs Belhaj and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government confirmed reports that Russia paid Afghan fighters to kill US soldiers, whether US intelligence had informed the Netherlands, and whether Dutch troops in Afghanistan were at higher risk. The ministers answered that the government does not publicly comment on cooperation with foreign intelligence services or specific intelligence, that allied services would normally share information affecting each other's soldiers, and that general threat levels are monitored with precautions taken where needed.
As is well known, the cabinet makes no public statements about cooperation with and between foreign intelligence services.
Het kabinet doet, zoals bekend, in het openbaar geen mededelingen over de samenwerking met en tussen buitenlandse inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'Theater Markant wil wel showroom voor Nederland worden'

MP Belhaj asked the minister about a theatre's COVID-19 safety protocol using splash screens, whether it should be rolled out nationally, and whether choir singing could resume under strict conditions. The minister said the sector drafts protocols and government only advises, that TNO found indoor splash screens insufficiently safe, and that choirs may rehearse and perform under RIVM guidelines.
Protocols are drawn up by the sector and it is up to the sector to roll out a protocol nationally.
Protocollen worden opgesteld door de sector en het is aan de sector om een protocol landelijk uit te rollen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Paleis Noordeinde deze zomer niet open voor publiek’

MPs Belhaj and Sneller asked why Paleis Noordeinde and the Koninklijke Stallen cannot reopen to the public this summer like museums, suggesting ticketed time slots over more days. Prime Minister Rutte answered that access is a matter for the King under article 41 of the Constitution, weighing COVID-19 measures, and that an online alternative is being developed instead.
Access to the palaces is a matter governed by article 41 of the Constitution: the King arranges his household, taking the public interest into account.
De toegang tot de paleizen is een aangelegenheid waarvoor artikel 41 van de Grondwet geldt: de Koning richt, met inachtneming van het openbaar belang, zijn huis in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Dure borrels, feestjes en uitjes: Defensie legt miljoenenuitgaven aan banden’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports of costly staff parties and asked for an explanation of the Walibi family day cost breakdown, the pressures behind it, and new spending rules. The minister gave the per-FTE cost figures, a breakdown of the roughly 630,000 euro Walibi event, extra KMar funding, gift rules and new limits on team events, without any explicit commitment to further action.
See below the breakdown of the costs for the staff outing.
Zie onderstaand de verdeling van de kosten voor het personeelsuitje
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'Bellingcat: Bierapp Untappd kan gebruikt worden om militairen te volgen'

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that the beer app Untappd could be used to track soldiers, raising concerns about leaked personal data and national security. The minister acknowledged the risks, said existing defence security policy from 2018 still applies, and stated that Defence relies on awareness, risk assessment and mission-specific rules rather than new concrete measures.
Defence is aware of the vulnerabilities that smart devices bring.
Defensie is zich bewust van de kwetsbaarheden die smart devices met zich meebrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Overheid voor rechter om etnische profileren: ‘Zo vernederend dat je kleur bepalend is’

An MP asked about reports of ethnic profiling by the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee (KMar) at Eindhoven Airport, including the use of ethnicity as a risk indicator in mobile border checks, its proportionality, complaints and evaluations. The government answered that ethnicity is never a standalone indicator and is used only with other objective indicators, that no legal changes are needed, and that complaints are handled through an independent committee while evaluations and optimisation of profiling methods continue.
Ethnicity is never a standalone risk factor, but is always applied as an indicator in combination with other indicators.
Etniciteit is nooit een op zichzelf staande risicofactor, maar wordt als indicator altijd in combinatie met andere indicatoren toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Belhaj en Groothuizen over een Nederlandse bijdrage aan een gereactiveerde ‘Sophia-missie’

MPs Sjoerdsma, Belhaj and Groothuizen asked the ministers about the Berlin Libya conference, the EU arms embargo monitoring role, reactivating the Sophia mission, humanitarian and migration effects, and a Dutch contribution. The government welcomed the Berlin outcomes, said EUNAVFOR MED Irini (succeeding Sophia) will implement the UN arms embargo, and said a Dutch contribution of staff officers in Rome is likely while further capacity decisions await military advice.
The cabinet is still considering a possible contribution with other capabilities.
Het kabinet beraadt zich nog op een eventuele bijdrage met andere capaciteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Diertens over de gevolgen van het coronavirus voor de culturele sector

Two D66 MPs asked how the government will cushion the coronavirus fallout for the cultural sector, given many freelancers and self-employed artists, and what support schemes exist. The minister answered that the sector can use general economic relief measures, that rent and subsidy leniency has been agreed with several bodies, that a new self-employed benefit scheme without means test is being set up, and that consultations with the sector are ongoing.
Depending on developments, the cabinet will take necessary and appropriate follow-up measures if the situation calls for them.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen, zal het kabinet noodzakelijke en passende vervolgmaatregelen treffen indien de situatie daartoe noopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de berichten ‘Cruciaal IT-project bij Defensie dreigt te mislukken’ en ‘In een digitale oorlog doet de Nederlandse krijgsmacht er nu niet toe’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Defence about reports that the GrIT IT project may fail, including the reported price ceiling, the exclusive rights bought from IBM/Atos, threatened damage claims, the continuity of Defence IT, and the BIT advice. The State Secretary answers most questions, largely by referring to commercial confidentiality, the ongoing tender and a confidential briefing, while promising a confidential letter and a BIT review expected in Q3 2020.
During the procurement I make no statements about commercially confidential information.
Tijdens de aanbesteding doe ik geen uitspraken over commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over de EU Battlegroup

Two MPs asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the EU Battlegroup: whether the Netherlands leads it with Germany in 2020, why Battlegroups have never been deployed, and whether they could support UN missions. The minister confirmed the Netherlands' contribution and explained that unanimity, operational and financial obstacles have blocked deployment, while committing to explore a Battlegroup role in a UN mission before summer 2020.
I promised the House to inform it about this before summer 2020. I will keep this commitment.
Ik beloofde de Kamer hierover voor de zomer 2020 te informeren. Ik zal deze toezegging gestand doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller, Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht 'Rutte informeert Tweede Kamer onjuist over kunstverkoop Oranjes'

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister about reports that the Munnicks van Cleeff atlas, a Raden Saleh painting and other art from Princess Juliana's estate were sold or kept out of museums against advice, and about the handling of the estate and the tax-credit scheme. The government answered that legal constraints on privacy and tax confidentiality limit disclosure of the estate settlement, that the atlas sale was not subject to a binding guarantee of staying in the Netherlands, and that the policy on displaying art acquired via the scheme is not legally binding but policy-based, with a commitment to follow the advisory committee's report.
As I noted in answer to question 2, various statutory provisions prevent a full account of the concrete settlement of the estate among the various private heirs and other parties.

Zoals ik in antwoord op vraag 2 heb opgemerkt staan verschillende wettelijke voorschriften er aan in de weg volledig in te gaan op de concrete afwikkeling van de nalatenschap tussen de verschillende particuliere erfgenamen en andere betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht 'Vluchtelingenwerk bezorgd om uitzetting Afghaanse tolk'

MPs Belhaj, Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether an Afghan former interpreter for the US army, refused asylum and facing deportation, is consistent with government statements on risk groups for interpreters in Afghanistan, and how such cases are weighed. The government declined to discuss individual cases, explained that interpreters who worked for international missions are now treated as a systematically persecuted group following a motion, and estimated about ten former local staff granted asylum.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Van Weyenberg en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Een ongeluk waar je niets van leert’

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about a 2018 helicopter training accident involving the Coast Guard's SAR contractor, the unreported incident, and unclear inspection and safety responsibilities across ILT, Inspectie SZW and contractors. The government answered that the accident was reported by the worker, that an inspection into the employer's failure to report will be started, and that responsibilities are divided among several inspectorates, while rejecting claims of unacceptable shortcomings.
ISZW will launch an investigation into this.
Er wordt door ISZW een onderzoek hiernaar ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'De Nederlandse ‘precisiebom’ op een wapendepot van IS'

An MP from D66 asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports of a Dutch precision bomb on an IS arms depot near Hawija in June 2015, including the targeting checks, civilian casualties, transparency and compensation. The minister answered that Dutch targeting checks were applied, that the strike caused unintended secondary explosions and roughly 70 casualties, that Dutch involvement is now acknowledged, and that compensation falls to Iraq and no individual claims were made to Defence.
This Hawija case was one of the cases mentioned there.
Dit geval in Hawija betrof een van de daar vermelde gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Geef burger ook veteranenstatus’

An MP asked whether civilian personnel (diplomats, police, aid workers) deployed alongside soldiers in mission areas should receive veteran status and access to the same care. The government answered that civilians receive recognition via the Herinneringsmedaille and existing care arrangements, but that veteran status under the Veteranenwet is tied to the special legal position of military personnel and is therefore not appropriate for civilians.
On the basis of the Veterans Act and the provisions based on it, granting veteran status to diplomats, police officers and aid workers is therefore not appropriate.
Op basis van de Veteranenwet en de daarop berustende bepalingen is het toekennen van de veteranenstatus aan diplomaten, politieagenten en hulpverleners derhalve niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘’Russen’ intimideren vrouwen Nederlandse F16-vliegers’

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether reports that Russia intimidates the wives of Dutch F-16 pilots are accurate, how often this happens, and what protection Defence offers military personnel and families. The minister acknowledged the hybrid threat and described briefings, reporting procedures and a VPN service, but gave no incident figures and said attribution is not always possible.
Is there anything to say, if necessary confidentially, about how often this has happened in recent years and whether these intimidation practices have increased?
Is er iets te zeggen, desnoods vertrouwelijk, over hoe vaak dit de afgelopen jaren is gebeurd en in welke mate sprake is van een toename van deze intimidatiepraktijken?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Commando’s: ’de Baas’ heeft veel dodelijke aanslagen voorkomen’

MPs Belhaj and Sjoerdsma asked the Defence Minister about a report that a human source ('Windhond32') working for the MIVD prevented many deadly attacks, including claims about his debts, PTSD treatment, and a request for a meeting, and about a letter from Commando troops. The Minister declined to confirm or comment on the MIVD's activities and sources, citing the need for care with human sources, and said an unsigned letter could not be answered specifically.
I cannot make any public statements about the activities of the MIVD and the possible deployment of human sources.
Over de activiteiten van de MIVD en de eventuele inzet van menselijke bronnen kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Afghaanse tolken die Nederlanders hielpen onder vuur’

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister about reports that Afghan interpreters who worked for Dutch forces are being hunted and killed by the Taliban and ISIS, and about the asylum route and any special arrangement for them. The Minister answered that individual cases are assessed under a standing procedure via Foreign Affairs, Defence and the IND, with no special asylum scheme, and that threat levels for individual interpreters are unknown.
There is no special (asylum) arrangement for Afghans who worked for us at the time.
Zoals eerder gemeld, is er geen sprake van een speciale (asiel)regeling voor Afghanen die destijds voor ons hebben gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de motie Belhaj c.s. (30139, nr. 190)

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister how the government is implementing the adopted Belhaj motion allowing veterans with under 15 years of service to wear uniform at veterans' events, and whether veterans will be informed of its consequences. The answers were given by reference to a separate letter to parliament on uniform-wearing rights for veterans, with no substantive answers in this document.
The written questions from MP Belhaj (D66), question number 2019Z10933, have been answered by means of the letter 'Draagrecht uniformen veteranen' (Parliamentary Paper 30 139, no. 212).
Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Belhaj (D66), vraagnummer 2019Z10933 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Draagrecht uniformen veteranen» (Kamerstuk 30 139, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Piloot F-16 over strijd tegen IS: Mijn grootste angst was pech’

An MP asked the Defence Minister why a Dutch F-16 pilot's public interview about anti-IS air strikes fits with the ministry's refusal to share strike data and locations or civilian casualty figures, and whether that data could now be released. The minister answered that the pilot disclosed nothing beyond information already shared with parliament, that no operational security is at stake now the mission has ended, and that specific strike data and locations will not be released, while pointing to existing reporting and coalition civilian-casualty processes.
In this context the cabinet chooses not to release specific details on the dates and/or locations of air strikes during the F-16 deployment period in Iraq and eastern Syria.
In dit kader kiest het kabinet ervoor om geen specifieke details vrij te geven over data en/of locaties van luchtaanvallen gedurende de inzetperiode van de F-16’s in Irak en Oost-Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Paternotte over het bericht 'In paniek naar de grond om 'vreemde' actie met Boeing en F-16’s'

D66 MPs Belhaj and Paternotte asked the Defence Minister about a surprise F-16 flyby over Amsterdam with a Boeing 777 and whether it was deliberately kept quiet, including its safety assessment and costs. The minister said no secrecy was intended, the flight stayed within minimum altitudes, safety was guaranteed under existing procedures, and the costs were standard training, while leaving the future use of fighter jets for societal events to case-by-case judgement.
There is no question of secrecy regarding the air show.
Er is geen sprake van geheimhouding van de luchtvaartvertoning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Belhaj over het bericht "Angst voor lekken giftige stoffen uit 30 miljoen kilo munitie in Oosterschelde: 'Er moet echt wat gebeuren'

MPs Schonis and Belhaj asked about fears that 30 million kilos of old wartime munitions dumped in the Oosterschelde and North Sea could leak toxic substances and harm the environment and public health. The State Secretary of Defence answered that monitoring studies since 1998 show the risk is very small, that monitoring will continue, and that a regional information session and a summary of past reports are planned.
Rijkswaterstaat and Defence will jointly prepare a summary overview of all research reports and letters previously submitted to the House of Representatives.
Rijkswaterstaat en Defensie zullen daartoe gezamenlijk een samenvattend overzicht maken van alle in het verleden aan de Tweede Kamer aangeboden onderzoeksrapporten en Kamerbrieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘De JSF: een ongeluk in slow motion’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports on serious F-35 deficiencies found by US testing bodies, including the number of critical limitations, safety risks, ALIS maintenance problems, cost consequences and reliability targets. The State Secretary answered that 15 Category 1 deficiencies remain (ten on the F-35A), mitigation measures are in place, cost effects are not yet foreseeable, and further reporting will follow in the annual project report.
The identification of deficiencies is a snapshot, so the number of shortcomings fluctuates.
De vaststelling van de deficiencies is een momentopname waardoor het aantal tekortkomingen wisselt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Oranjes verkochten in stilte kunst aan Rijk’

MPs Belhaj and Sneller asked whether the state bought royal art and heritage objects since the 1980s, whether a list of purchases can be published, and why public access is limited. The minister answered that only palace-bound inventory was bought and placed with the Royal Household, that private owners decide on disclosure and sales, and that some palaces are partly open to the public.
Regarding openness and transparency for art held in private ownership, I note that it is up to the private owner to decide whether and how insight is given.
Wat betreft openbaarheid en transparantie bij kunstbezit in privé eigendom merk ik op dat het aan de particuliere eigenaar is om te bepalen of, en op welke wijze, inzicht wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Oranjes verkochten in stilte kunst aan Rijk’

Two D66 MPs asked whether a Rubens drawing and other artworks sold by princess Christina at Sotheby's had ever belonged to a Orange foundation, and if so how they moved to private ownership. The minister answered simply that they had not.
No, that is not the case.
Nee, dat is niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Belhaj over de herijking van de businesscase voor civiele dienstauto’s, zoals genoemd in de Najaarsnota 2018

MPs Sneller and Belhaj asked the Defence Minister about the revised business case for civilian service cars, including fleet numbers, cost and sale-value adjustments, and a correction to the Najaarsnota 2018 text. The state secretary answered in detail on replacement terms, the EUR 59.2 million downward revision, the BPM error in earlier sale-value estimates, operating costs and cash flows, and acknowledged the Najaarsnota error.
