I note that an error was made in the text of the Najaarsnota regarding Defence's civilian service cars.
Ik merk op dat er een fout is gemaakt in de tekst van de Najaarsnota over de civiele dienstauto's van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Belhaj over het bericht 'Defensie vervroegt vervanging vipvliegtuig'

MPs Sneller and Belhaj asked whether Defence plans to replace the government Gulfstream IV early, why parliament was not informed, the cost and business case, and whether this priority is morally defensible while staff lack a collective agreement. The State Secretary confirmed earlier replacement (before 2022) due to ageing and groundings, said parliament will receive the A-brief, stated the purchase will be under 100 million euro, and said procurement is not linked to pay negotiations.
In the A-brief I will inform the House about the replacement of the Gulfstream IV.
In de A-brief zal ik de Kamer informeren over de vervanging van de Gulfstream IV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'Defensie ziet liever geen windmolens naast munitieopslag'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Defence whether wind turbines should be kept out of the A-zone around the Staphorst ammunition depot for safety reasons, what the legal limits in that zone are, and how this fits with Defence's sustainability goals. The State Secretary answered that Defence raised concerns in a zoning submission requiring quantitative safety research, that no explicit legal ban exists on wind turbines in the A-zone, and that turbines could be allowed if a risk analysis shows no negative effect on external safety.
There is therefore no explicit prohibition in law on placing wind turbines in the A-zone.
Er is in de wet dus geen expliciet verbod op de plaatsing van windmolens in de A-zone opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Kerstens en Den Boer over politiek verlof voor militairen om uitzending mogelijk te maken

MPs Belhaj, Kerstens and Den Boer asked whether soldiers can get political leave to attend council or assembly meetings, and whether elected councillors can temporarily transfer their seat to enable deployment abroad. The government answered that soldiers can get extraordinary leave for council duties, but that the Kieswet and Constitution allow temporary seat replacement only for pregnancy, childbirth and illness, so a constitutional amendment would be needed and it is not convinced this is necessary.
An extension of the replacement option for military deployments abroad therefore requires an amendment of the Constitution.
Een uitbreiding van de vervangingsmogelijkheid bij buitenlandse missies van militairen vereist dus een wijziging van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht 'Koninklijke cadeaus, vorstelijke problemen: hoe de Oranjes omgaan met geschenken'

MPs Belhaj and Sneller asked the Prime Minister about reports that a Rubens drawing sold at auction may have been on loan from a royal foundation, and whether ownership and the sale had been properly checked. The government answered that the publications do not change its earlier position that the work is private property, that the sale is for the private owner to decide, that no RVD involvement was found, and that it cannot establish whether other works sit in royal foundations.
It is up to the private owner to decide whether, and in what manner, an artwork is sold.
Het is aan de particuliere eigenaar om te bepalen of, en op welke wijze, een kunstwerk wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de verkoop door de koninklijke familie van een Rubens tekening titel Nude Study of A Young Man with Raised Arms

An MP asked whether the royal family should have offered a Rubens drawing to Dutch museums before selling it at an American auction, and whether the Prime Minister would appeal to the family to keep it in the Netherlands. The minister replied that the work is private property, that the owner decides how to sell, that existing museum funding instruments exist, and that there is no reason to make an exception for the royal family.
It is up to the private owner to decide whether, and in what manner, an artwork is sold.
Het is aan de particuliere eigenaar om te bepalen of, en op welke wijze, een kunstwerk wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Honderden militairen slapen in hotels omdat barakken Huis ter Heide te slecht zijn’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence why hundreds of soldiers at Huis ter Heide were sleeping in hotels because barracks were unfit, and about safety, costs and renovation. The government confirmed the barracks failed minimum requirements, explained the phased demolition, renovation and fire-safety programme, and reported about 700,000 euro spent on temporary hotel rooms, while costs for renovation and new build are not yet known.
After complaints from personnel housed at the Walaardt Sacré Camp in Huis ter Heide, it was established that the accommodation does not meet the minimum requirements.
Na klachten van personeel gelegerd op het Walaardt Sacré Kamp te Huis ter Heide is vastgesteld dat de legering niet voldoet aan de minimale eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Belhaj over het aanhoudend gebruik van chroom-6 bij de Koninklijke Luchtmacht

MPs Karabulut and Belhaj asked the State Secretary of Defence about the continued use of chromium-6 in High Solids Primer on Royal Netherlands Air Force aircraft, including whether it contains double the chromium-6 of the earlier paint, whether Belgium and Norway use chromium-free paints, and why certification of alternatives stalled. The government answered that the higher solids percentage does not mean more chromium-6 added, that a roadmap toward chromium-free systems is due by 1 March 2019, and that exposure stays below legal limits with protective equipment.
This plan will be ready by 1 March 2019 at the latest.
Dit plan is uiterlijk 1 maart 2019 gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Karabulut over het nieuws dat de bescherming van defensiepersoneel tegen chroom-6 nog steeds onvoldoende is

MPs Belhaj and Karabulut asked whether defence personnel are adequately protected against chromium-6 exposure, whether measured levels exceed the 1 µg/m3 limit, and whether protective measures and equipment (spray booths, gas-mask filters) are adequate. The State Secretary answered that spray-booth air concentrations can exceed the limit but personnel wear protective masks, that replacement booths and chromium-free alternatives are planned with long timelines, and that the AMF-12 filters were replaced as a precaution, with a full-risk elimination not possible and structural measures targeted for end 2020.
Defence naturally aims to improve working conditions so that wearing respiratory protection is no longer necessary.
Defensie streeft er uiteraard naar om de werksituaties zodanig te verbeteren dat het dragen van adembescherming niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Belhaj over het bericht 'Jassenblunder gevolg van ‘inschattingsfout’'

MPs Bruins Slot and Belhaj asked the Defence State Secretary about cold-weather injuries among soldiers in exercises Bison Drawsko and Enhanced Forward Presence, and about winter clothing procurement for Trident Juncture. The State Secretary answered that about 35 cold injuries were reported in each case, that winter clothing is being supplied centrally, and that the procurement rules already allow exceptions in urgent situations.
The Ministry of Defence, including the KPU company, has all the options available in tenders that are included in the Procurement Act 2012 and the Procurement Act for the defence and security sector.

Het Ministerie van Defensie, inclusief het KPU-bedrijf, beschikt bij aanbestedingen over alle mogelijkheden, die in de Aanbestedingswet 2012 en de Aanbestedingswet op defensie- en veiligheidsgebied zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Militairen zonder handschoenen in ijskoud Polen’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports that soldiers lacked gloves and used body armour past its expiry date, and about fire-resistant clothing, cold-weather gear and weapon stocks. The government answered that armour is replaced when damaged rather than at a fixed expiry, that TNO testing found most plates intact, and that extra gear was ordered, while the Bison Drawsko cold-weather shortage was acknowledged and addressed through later procurement.
After questions from KCT staff at the end of August 2018 about the warranty date of the ballistic plates in KCT's individual ballistic protection, immediate action was taken.
Na vragen van medewerkers van het KCT eind augustus 2018 over de garantiedatum van de kogelwerende platen in de individuele ballistische bescherming van het KCT is direct actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat de Europese parlement killerrobots wil verbieden

MP Belhaj asked the Defence Minister about the European Parliament's resolution calling for a ban on lethal autonomous weapons and whether the Netherlands would lead such a ban, and asked what steps had followed the 2015 AIV advisory report. The minister answered that all weapons must stay under meaningful human control, that the Netherlands opposes a ban or moratorium while working through the CCW and Article 36 reviews, and that the advisory report will be revisited in 2020.
The cabinet rejects in advance the development and use of autonomous systems that are not under human control.
Het kabinet verwerpt op voorhand de ontwikkeling en inzet van autonome systemen die niet onder menselijke controle staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Defensie betaalt fikse rekeningen van Kroon’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Defence paid large legal bills for a major, and whether the reimbursement rules for military personnel and veterans' legal aid were applied consistently. The minister explained that cases are judged individually, that deviating from the standard scheme was justified by the case's exceptional public profile, and promised a review of the veterans' compensation scheme including legal aid caps.
There is no deviation, but rather application of a different legal basis in cases where matters qualify for it.
Er is geen sprake van een afwijking, maar van toepassing van een andere grondslag in de gevallen waarin zaken daarvoor in aanmerking komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj inzake het bericht ‘Eerste energieneutrale kazerne ter wereld op Aruba’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports of an energy-neutral barracks on Aruba and whether such projects reflect wider Defence policy. The state secretary answered that Defence has a broader sustainability programme for its real estate and renewable energy projects, with the energy and environment policy to be consolidated in a new document by spring 2019.

The Operational Energy Strategy and the Defence Energy and Environmental Policy Note will be merged, so that by next spring there is a single integrated policy document covering energy policy for both real estate and equipment.

De Operationele Energiestrategie en de Defensie Energie en Milieubeleidsnota zullen worden samengevoegd, zodat er komend voorjaar één integraal beleidsdocument ligt dat het energiebeleid voor zowel vastgoed als materieel bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Luchtmacht klaar voor bewapende drone’

MP Belhaj (D66) asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the Air Force commander's interview about arming the MALE UAV drone was coordinated with or approved by the ministry, and whether arming drones is consistent with earlier statements and the Defence White Paper. The State Secretary confirmed knowledge of and consent to the interview, stated that arming the MALE UAV is not under consideration and does not appear in the Defence policy, and declined to address ethical or budgetary questions beyond that.
I was aware of his interview and permission was given for it.
Ik was op de hoogte van zijn interview en er is toestemming voor gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat de Koninklijke Marechaussee etnisch profileert op Eindhoven Airport

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister whether the Royal Military Police (KMar) engages in ethnic profiling at Eindhoven Airport, after a reported incident with several dark-skinned travellers pulled aside, and asked about follow-up to an Ombudsman report and complaint handling. The government answered that non-discrimination is the starting point, that profiling may include appearance but only alongside objective indicators, that the KMar has contacted the complainant and invited a formal complaint, and that it has reviewed its methods and will report on profiling in its annual integrity report.
These profiles are confidential and are used internally.
Profielen zijn vertrouwelijk en worden intern gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Belhaj over het bericht “Schiphol teruggefloten door rechter”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about a court ruling that Schiphol must release about 2,500 slots, and about its consequences for passenger flows, border control queues, security and the 500,000-movement cap. The minister replied that the ruling has no policy consequences for the 2017/2018 season, that the cap through 2020 stands, and that Marechaussee capacity is being expanded, while declining to comment on Schiphol's reasoning.
I do not consider it appropriate to comment on the justification of this decision by Schiphol, because the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management is not a party in this case.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om commentaar te geven op de onderbouwing van dit besluit door Schiphol omdat het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geen partij is in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Belhaj en Weverling over de berichten 'Spionnenjacht blokt 5G' en 'Arena geen proeftuin voor nieuwste generatie mobiel internet'

MPs Paternotte, Belhaj and Weverling asked about press reports that intelligence services are blocking 5G rollout in the 3.5 GHz band and that the Amsterdam Arena cannot serve as a 5G testbed. The State Secretary says the rollout is important, that talks with intelligence services and neighbouring countries are ongoing, and that a solution and options will be sent to parliament around mid-2018.

Both the ministers of Defence and of the Interior and the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and Climate are working to find, on the basis of technical research, solution options for making the 3.5 GHz band available.

Zowel de ministers van Defensie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijkrelaties als de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en Klimaat zetten zich in om op basis van technisch onderzoek tot oplossingsmogelijkheden te komen voor de beschikbaarstelling van de 3,5 GHz-band.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Belhaj over fraude met oorlogswrakken in de Java-zee

Two MPs (Van Haga and Belhaj) asked ministers of Defence and Education, Culture and Science about reports of illegal salvage of Dutch WWII wrecks in the Java Sea, including permits and possible mass burial of remains. The ministers answered that Indonesia denies issuing permits, that the coordinates do not match the wrecks, that further joint on-site investigation is being arranged, and that next of kin are being informed.
The Netherlands is therefore currently in close consultation with the Indonesian authorities about the possibility of follow-up on-site investigation.
Nederland voert daarom op dit ogenblik nauw overleg met de Indonesische autoriteiten over de mogelijkheid van vervolgonderzoek ter plaatse.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Van den Hul over het pleidooi van de militaire vakbond voor het instellen van een onafhankelijk meldpunt naar aanleiding van berichtgeving door de Volkskrant over een oud-militai

MPs Belhaj and Van den Hul asked the Defence Minister about a union call for an independent reporting point for sexual abuse in the armed forces, after a Volkskrant report on a former soldier abused in the 1980s, and about training, anonymity, time-barred cases and disciplinary action. The Minister answered that existing channels (COID, KMar, supervisors) are adequate and that fragmentation is undesirable, that anonymous reports are possible, and that a commission of inquiry is examining the specific case, with action depending on its outcome.
Defence has set up a commission of inquiry that specifically focuses on the case in question.
Defensie heeft een commissie van onderzoek ingesteld die zich specifiek richt op de casus in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het beleidsplan 'Diversiteit & Inclusiviteit'

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the 'Diversity & Inclusiveness' policy plan, its goals, KPIs, timeline, recruitment via the Multicultural Network, training, reporting willingness and regulations. The minister answered in general terms, citing the plan's focus on a socially safe, respectful workplace and ongoing activities, and promised a review of regulations, with few quantified targets.
Should this review show that current regulations insufficiently support or even hinder an inclusive working climate, they will be revised.
Mocht uit deze doorlichting blijken dat huidige regelgeving een inclusief werkklimaat onvoldoende ondersteunt of zelfs hindert, dan zal die worden herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het stilleggen van oefeningen en opleidingen van de commando’s

An MP asks the Defence Minister about reports that nearly all training and shooting exercises for the Korps Commandotroepen were halted, the reasons, duration, effects on readiness, and why parliament was not informed. The minister answers that the halt follows OVV recommendations after the Ossendrecht shooting accident, that a controlled review of all 63 courses is underway with most resuming in September-October, that deployments remain fully prepared, and that a Defence investigation and a policy response to the OVV will be sent to parliament.
Defence will provide the OVV with a comprehensive policy response within the six-month term, and as much sooner as possible. The House will of course receive this policy response.
Defensie zal de OVV binnen de gestelde termijn van zes maanden, en zoveel sneller als mogelijk, een uitgebreide beleidsreactie aanbieden. De Kamer zal deze beleidsreactie vanzelfsprekend ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over de escalatie tussen Rusland en VS inzake de strijd in Syrië

MPs Belhaj and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers about the US shootdown of a Syrian jet, Russia's threat against coalition aircraft, the effect on the fight against ISIS and the Dutch tanker, and reports of rising civilian deaths and changed rules of engagement. The government answered that it lacks facts to assess the shootdown, that the fight against ISIS continues, that the Dutch tanker's deployment is unchanged, that the US says its rules of engagement were not changed, and that at least 484 civilian casualties from coalition action have been acknowledged.
The cabinet does not have the necessary facts to further interpret this attack.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde feiten om deze aanval verder te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de aanhoudende stremmingen bij de Coentunnel en de rol van de instelling van de meetapparatuur

An MP asked the minister whether truck height detections at the Coentunnel, which the minister says are not false, cause unnecessary closures and whether the measuring system is accurate, given that few fines followed. The minister replied that the system is periodically checked and functions correctly, that fines are the responsibility of the Public Prosecution Service, and that Rijkswaterstaat is pursuing measures to reduce tall trucks.
Rijkswaterstaat does not have figures showing how often the police attend on site and how often a fine is issued in those cases.
Rijkswaterstaat beschikt niet over cijfers die aangeven hoe vaak de politie ter plaatse komt en hoe vaak in die gevallen een bekeuring wordt uitgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Eijsink, Van Bommel en Belhaj over het gebruik van een door Nederland gefinancierd mortuarium in Afghanistan als jongensbordeel

MPs asked whether the government knew that a mortuary it helped fund near Kamp Holland in Tarin Kowt, Afghanistan, was used as a brothel for boys (bacha bazi), when it was discovered, and what measures followed. The government answered that it had no information during ISAF that the building was misused, learned of it from the Brandpunt broadcast, raised child abuse with local leaders regularly, and confirmed it financed the mortuary (about EUR 15,000) in 2008.
During the ISAF mission the cabinet had no information showing that the mortuary was being used for other purposes.
Het kabinet beschikte gedurende de ISAF-missie niet over informatie waaruit bleek dat het mortuarium voor andere doeleinden werd gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de aanhoudende stremmingen door te hoge vrachtwagens in de Coentunnel

An MP asked the minister about repeated closures of the Coentunnel caused by overheight trucks, including the number of height reports, economic damage, and whether further measures will be taken. The minister reports 1,185 height reports in 2016, a slight decline, describes ongoing Rijkswaterstaat measures such as signage and industry outreach, and says no further measures are planned beyond the ongoing pilot and dialogue with the sector.
Rijkswaterstaat does not have current calculations of economic damage.
Rijkswaterstaat beschikt niet over actuele berekeningen van economische schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de omgang van Nederland met het seksueel misbruik van minderjarige jongens (‘bacha bazi’) in Afghanistan

MP Belhaj asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers how the Netherlands handled bacha bazi (sexual abuse of boys) in Afghanistan, including pre-deployment briefing, protocols, reports by soldiers and Afghan criminal law. The ministers answered that no specific protocols existed, one 2007 incident was reported to Afghan police without known prosecution, and they would raise children's rights in existing dialogues.
There are no specific guidelines or protocols for Dutch soldiers on how to act regarding bacha bazi.
Er zijn geen specifieke richtlijnen of protocollen voor Nederlandse militairen hoe zij moeten handelen ten aanzien van «bacha bazi».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat de ontwikkeling van moderne communicatie richting omwonenden Schiphol vastloopt

An MP asks why a promised modern social-media strategy and smartphone app giving residents near Schiphol real-time flight information has not materialised a year after the Belhaj motion, and whether funding is the bottleneck. The State Secretary replies that a stakeholder taskforce adopted a strategy in September 2016, that the app development has been ordered with a EUR 75,000 contribution, and that progress will be reported to the Chamber before summer.
On the progress regarding delivery of the mobile application under development, I will inform the Chamber before the summer.
Over de voortgang met betrekking tot de oplevering van de in ontwikkeling zijnde mobiele applicatie zal ik de Kamer voor de zomer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Belhaj over de berichten over de situatie bij de luchtvaartmaatschappij Insel Air

MPs Belhaj and Pechtold asked the government about safety concerns and the financial crisis at Insel Air, the Caribbean airline, including why action came late, why civil servants were barred from flying with it, and what happens to connectivity if it fails. The State Secretary answered that signals were received late 2016, inspections by ILT and cooperation with Curaçao and Aruba followed, a travel precaution for civil servants was adopted, and an expert group on regional connectivity was set up.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels, Belhaj en Van Veldhoven over de berichten 'Druk aan de Poort' en 'Zelfverrijking normale gang van zaken bij Rotterdams containerbedrijf'

D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and Security, Infrastructure and Environment, and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that many containers in Rotterdam port are not systematically scanned for nuclear material and that fraud occurred at a container firm. The government answered that customs uses a risk-based approach, that scanning and inspection capacity was adequate for the Second Maasvlakte, that radiological screening is applied where feasible, and that it cannot comment on ongoing investigations.
However, I cannot make any statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik echter geen mededeling doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over de verdwenen oorlogsgraven van Nederlanders in de Javazee

MPs Sjoerdsma and Belhaj asked whether the government will pursue an international treaty to protect war graves at sea, what contacts with other states produced, whether wrecks of Dutch warships were towed to Surabaya and sold as scrap, and when the investigation will conclude. The minister replied that existing law already protects warship wrecks, that contacts with several states have taken place, that it is too early to confirm the scrapping report, and that no concrete timeline exists yet, though results will be shared.
Of course we will inform you about the outcome of the investigation.
Uiteraard zullen wij u informeren over de uitkomst van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Bergkamp, Koser Kaya en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Politie heeft geen zicht op dumpingen drugsafval’

Four D66 MPs asked the ministers whether police and partner agencies have sufficient visibility and capacity over illegal dumping and discharge of synthetic drug waste, given a report that many dumpings go undetected and carry health and environmental risks. The government answered that dumping is difficult to detect, that enforcement focuses on production, that regional protocols and projects are being developed, and that it sees no need for additional research, controls or a national approach.
At this moment I see no reason for additional actions.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de handhaving van het strafpuntensysteem voor beginnersrijbewijzen

An MP from D66 asked why enforcement of the penalty-point system for novice drivers appears weak, citing very few suspensions, a sharp drop in traffic stops from 2007 to 2015, and the link to road safety goals. The Minister answered that the figures refer to prosecutor notifications rather than suspensions, attributed the drop mainly to police CAO actions and shifting priorities, listed enforcement priorities for 2016–2018, and committed to informing the House further and evaluating the novice regulation.
I informed your House by letter of 18 February 2016 about various topics concerning traffic enforcement.
Antwoord 11 Ik heb uw Kamer bij brief van 18 februari 2016 2 geïnformeerd over verschillende onderwerpen op het gebied van verkeershandhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het rapport ‘Zorg tussen wal en schip’

An MP asked several ministers about the OVV report on medical assistance at sea by the Kustwacht, covering staffing, investment, coordination with healthcare, and whether the Kustwacht annual report is sent to parliament. The minister defers substantive answers on most questions to a forthcoming full response to the OVV report, providing only partial information on summer incident patterns and the state of helicopter talks.
The answer to the above questions 2, 3, 4 and 5 I will include in my response to the OVV report.
Het antwoord op bovengenoemde vragen 2, 3, 4 en 5 neem ik mee in mijn reactie op het OVV-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de inzet van militairen op Schiphol

An MP asked the government about deploying Royal Netherlands Marechaussee support and army infantry at Schiphol, whether the promised 85 new marechaussees were truly additional, and why a structural solution was still pending. The minister answered that army support was a temporary, ended measure, that the 85 recruits were redirected from regular intake and phased in, and that a capacity needs assessment would be sent to parliament in autumn.
This autumn I will inform you further.
Dit najaar zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Jasper van Dijk over nieuwe onthullingen inzake de misstanden op vliegbasis Eindhoven

MPs Belhaj and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about new revelations of misconduct at Eindhoven air base, the scope and powers of the internal investigation, its timeline, and the status of the flares transport case. The minister declined to share the investigation's assignment details or findings before completion, promised to inform parliament of the outcome, and reported that prosecutors dropped the flares case without finding criminal offences.
Pending the investigation results, I will make no further statements on this.
In afwachting van de onderzoeksresultaten doe ik hier geen nadere uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de berichten ‘Ministerie: Schiphol moet lawaai beter berekenen. Milieurapport zaait twijfel over stillere startmethode’ en ‘Gesjoemel met herrie’

An MP asks whether a Commissie m.e.r. advice shows Schiphol used outdated noise calculation methods that overstate the noise gains of new departure procedures. The Secretary of State says the Dutch model was applied correctly, acknowledges the Commission's view that international methods yield smaller gains, and commits to commissioning a new Dutch model, further calculations, and involving the Omgevingsraad Schiphol.
In doing so, I explicitly distance myself from a deliberately rosy presentation of the noise effects.
Daarbij neem ik nadrukkelijk afstand van een met opzet te rooskleurige voorstelling over de geluidseffecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de stijging van het aantal ernstige ongevallen bij Defensie

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a reported rise in serious accidents at the Ministry of Defence, whether budget cuts caused it, and how the number will be reduced. The Minister answered that the rise in reported incidents reflects an improved reporting culture rather than worse safety, denied an increase in serious accidents, supplied the data as attachments, and described ongoing risk assessments and investigations of serious incidents.
The rise in the number of reports is partly related to the improved reporting culture at Defence.
De stijging van het aantal meldingen hangt onder meer samen met de verbeterde meldingscultuur bij Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over Nut en noodzaak van de aanschaf van MALE UAV (medium-altitude long-endurance unmanned aerial vehicle)

An MP asks the Defence Minister about the necessity, cost, procurement choice, training and ethics of acquiring MQ-9 Reaper MALE drones, which have been postponed. The minister answers that the need is for surveillance rather than armed drones, that the delay was a budget-driven prioritisation, that a lease option is being studied, and that the government supports an open international debate on armed drones.
As explained in the 2016 budget, Defence is examining whether this need can be met in an alternative way, for example through a leasing arrangement.
Zoals in de begroting voor 2016 is toegelicht onderzoekt Defensie of op alternatieve wijze, bijvoorbeeld via een leaseconstructie, in deze behoefte kan worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over fraude met NS-abonnementen

An MP asked the state secretary about fraud with NS rail subscriptions via fake names and foreign bank accounts, and whether the subscription system would be reviewed. The secretary said NS had closed the control gap, added a checks, that transport operators are responsible for their own fraud measures, and declined to review the system.
It is not for me but for transport operators to take measures to prevent fraud when taking out subscriptions.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan vervoerders om maatregelen te treffen om fraude bij de abonnementsafsluiting tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat de Coentunnel vier keer per dag gestremd is door te hoge vrachtwagens

An MP asked the minister about reports that the Coentunnel is closed several times a day by overly high trucks, and whether this harms Amsterdam's accessibility and whether it will be fixed before summer 2016. The minister acknowledged 3-4 height-related closures per day, said the government is taking measures such as signage, sector talks and police priority, but defended the existing traffic flow and gave no new firm solution.
Rijkswaterstaat monitors the number of overly high vehicles.
Rijkswaterstaat monitort het aantal te hoge voertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het uitbesteden van militairen taken

An MP asked the Defence Minister for an overview of military tasks outsourced to private parties in the missions in Mali, Iraq/eastern Syria, Afghanistan and Somalia. The minister answered that outsourced tasks are mainly support services and declined to name the companies, citing security reasons.
For security reasons, the names of the companies and organisations cooperating in this context are not made public.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen worden de namen van de bedrijven en organisaties waarmee in dit verband wordt samengewerkt, niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse luchtmacht naar een alternatief voor de F-35 zoekt

MP Belhaj asked whether the US Air Force search for an alternative to the F-35 (reported as a replacement for the A-10) should lead the Netherlands to reconsider its F-35 purchase and whether it would affect Dutch unit prices. The minister answered that the US is studying options for succeeding the A-10, not replacing the F-35, that the F-35 is a multirole aircraft with the required capabilities, and that US contract negotiations have historically lowered unit prices.
The US Air Force is not looking for an alternative to the F-35, but is examining alternatives for succeeding the A-10.
De Amerikaanse luchtmacht zoekt geen alternatief voor de F-35, maar onderzoekt alternatieven voor de opvolging van de A-10.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Verkeersveiligheid 130km-wegen onbekend’

MP Belhaj (D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether it is true that the causes of accidents on 130 km/h roads cannot be determined, how the 85 million euro for road safety on those roads was spent and what it achieved, and how causes could be better recorded. The minister answered that police reports give the location and circumstances but not the precise contribution of each factor, that the 85 million was largely spent on Meer Veilig 3 and AKOE measures with an evaluation planned for 2018, and that improving accident data is a general priority.
I will inform you further about this with the 2017 budget.
Ik zal u hierover bij de begroting 2017 nader informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het herzien van de wijze waarop het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu inbreng levert in onderzoeken en het onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de aanschaf van de Search and Rescu

An MP asked whether the ministry of Infrastructure and Environment would set rules on its input into studies, and why it did not disclose its involvement in the independent SAR helicopter study. The minister said internal guidance and an inter-departmental integrity process were underway, that the ministry was the commissioning party for the SAR study, and that involvement by Rijkswaterstaat did not compromise the study's independence.
The subject has since been raised in the Inter-departmental Platform on Integrity Management.
Het onderwerp is inmiddels ingebracht in het Interdepartementaal Platform Integriteitsmanagement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Belhaj over het bericht dat getraumatiseerde veteranen op straat dreigen te belanden

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary for health and the defence minister about reports that traumatised veterans may end up on the street after funding problems at the Compound in Assen, and whether national government should take a role given its supra-regional function. The state secretary said funding is secured for 2016, that the municipality and the Compound are seeking a multi-year solution, that no national role is foreseen under current responsibilities, and that no further central involvement is planned.

Under the current allocation of responsibilities agreed between central government and municipalities, the national government has no role regarding an additional national arrangement for care and support for the facilities the Compound in Assen provides to veterans.

In de huidige structuur van verantwoordelijkheden die zijn afgesproken tussen het Rijk en gemeenten is geen rol weggelegd voor het Rijk ten aanzien van een aanvullend landelijk arrangement voor zorg en ondersteuning voor de voorzieningen die de Compound in Assen aan veteranen biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over voortdurende problemen bij de MIVD

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the MIVD's internal problems, the publication of its staff magazine Ingelicht exposing personnel to danger, past dysfunction, cooperation with the AIVD, and reputational issues. The Minister rejected claims of amateurism, said the risks of publication are being handled without disclosing measures, and described cooperation with the AIVD as good, with a 2009 report finding no serious work-climate problems.
In order not to undermine the effectiveness of these measures, I do not provide information about their content.
Om de effectiviteit van deze maatregelen niet te ondermijnen, doe ik over de inhoud ervan geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat het Pentagon hackers uitnodigt de digitale beveiliging te doorbreken

An MP asked the Defence Minister how she assesses the Pentagon's 'Hack the Pentagon' bug-bounty pilot, whether the Netherlands should try it and pay per vulnerability, and how Defence currently cooperates with hackers. The minister answered that the pilot is limited to public websites, that Defence will inform parliament if a similar approach is chosen, that responsible disclosure is preferred over full disclosure and paying per leak is not applied, and that Defence works with experts and partners.
Should Defence wish to pursue a similar approach, the House of Representatives will be informed about it.
Mocht Defensie tot een soortgelijke aanpak willen overgaan, dan zal de Tweede Kamer hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over eventuele schadevergoeding voor Libanonveteranen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the Lebanon veterans' psychological complaints, delayed care, and the 163 pending claims following a court ruling on aftercare. The minister answered that care was provided, that Defence does not accept it has failed, and that claims are handled individually while the financial consequences of the court ruling will be reported before summer.
Defence has the duty to protect veterans as well as possible against the consequences of shocking experiences during missions.
Defensie heeft de plicht veteranen zo goed mogelijk te beschermen tegen de gevolgen van schokkende ervaringen tijdens missies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Fileprobleem neemt ook dit jaar verder toe’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the government shares the ANWB's concern that traffic congestion will keep rising in 2016 and whether commuting should be spread out. The minister confirmed the rise in congestion fits government forecasts, defended continued road building and the Beter Benutten programme, and said spreading commuter traffic is a promising but not sole solution, with talks with employers ongoing.
I expect that congestion will also increase this year, but less than the ANWB expects.
Ik verwacht dat de files dit jaar ook nog zullen toenemen, maar minder dan de ANWB verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Meer ongelukken door smartphone dan door bumperkleven’

An MP asks the transport minister about a US study finding that smartphone distraction causes more crashes than tailgating, whether its findings apply to the Netherlands, and whether the awareness campaign is effective. The minister answers that the US findings cannot simply be transferred, points to the ongoing UDrive study due in 2017, cites campaign evaluation data, and lists further measures such as the Fietsmodus app and a toolbox for employers.
To encourage this, I have asked VVN to create a toolbox for employers with low-threshold measures that contribute to responsible smartphone use.
Om dit te stimuleren heb ik VVN gevraagd een toolbox te maken voor werkgevers met laagdrempelige maatregelen die bijdragen aan verantwoord smartphonegebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat er nog steeds onveilig wordt gewerkt met het gif chroom 6

MP Belhaj asked the Defence Minister whether chromium-6 contamination found at the Den Helder naval yard means workers are still exposed, and what is being done to prevent unsafe work with the substance. The minister replied that wipe samples found chromium-6 but air measurements and urine analyses showed no exposure above limits, and pointed to a 2015 defence-wide directive restricting its use.
However, on the basis of wipe samples alone it cannot be concluded that personnel were exposed to chromium-6.
Op basis van veegmonsters alleen kan echter niet de conclusie worden getrokken dat personeel is blootgesteld aan chroom-6.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Belhaj over mensenhandel in Djibouti

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports of human trafficking and prostitution of young girls in Djibouti, including whether Dutch soldiers could contribute, and about Dutch use of the US trafficking classification and its human-rights stance toward Djibouti. The ministers answered that no Dutch soldiers are stationed there, that the Netherlands does not use its own classification system, and that bilateral relations with Djibouti are limited and indirect.
Our country has no classification system of its own.
Ons land heeft geen eigen classificatiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het kritische rapport van het Pentagon over de JSF

MP Belhaj asked the Defence Minister to respond to a critical Pentagon DOT&E report on the F-35 JSF, including concerns about an early block buy, mission data file shortcomings, low readiness and operational timelines. The Minister answered that a separate letter addresses the report, that a block buy is not yet decidable and will be discussed at the JESB, that the JPO is taking measures on mission data and readiness, and that Dutch initial operational capability is expected by end 2021 with full capability in 2024.
At the upcoming JSF Executive Steering Board (JESB) at the end of March, the Block Buy will be discussed in detail.
Tijdens de komende JSF Executive Steering Board (JESB) eind maart zal de Block Buy uitvoerig aan de orde komen.

m: Motie van het lid Sazias over meer aandacht voor preventie van ondervoeding bij ouderen
Asks the government to give home-care services more room in their task package to prevent malnutrition among older people.
considering that food is just as important as a clean home
overwegende dat voeding net zo belangrijk is als een schoon huis
Motie van het lid Ploumen c.s. over het continueren van de tweejaarlijkse screening op borstkanker
Asks the government to report to parliament before 1 March 2021 on how the two-yearly breast cancer screening interval can be maintained, including staffing solutions and additional funding.
requests the government to inform the House by 1 March 2021 how the two-year interval can be continued
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer voor 1 maart 2021 te berichten op welke wijze de termijn van twee jaar gecontinueerd kan worden
Motie van het lid Van Gerven c.s. over een backpay-regeling voor weduwen van ambtenaren of militairen die tijdens de Japanse bezetting een dienstverband hadden met het Nederlands-Indisch Gouvernement
Asks the cabinet to examine whether a backpay-style financial scheme is feasible for widows of civil servants and military personnel who were not fully paid during the Japanese occupation.
asks the cabinet to investigate whether such a financial scheme is feasible and implementable
vraagt het kabinet, te onderzoeken of een dergelijke financiële regeling haalbaar en uitvoerbaar is
Motie van de leden Ellemeet en Sazias over het doorbreken van het taboe op de overgang
Asks the government to explore how it can help break the taboo on menopause and raise women's knowledge, and to map with social partners how the taboo affects the labour market.
requests the government to investigate how it can contribute to breaking the taboo on the menopause
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken op welke wijze zij kan bijdragen aan het doorbreken van het taboe op de overgang
Motie van de leden Van der Staaij en Sazias over invulling geven aan de aanbevelingen van de landelijk aanjager respijtzorg
Asks the government to monitor how recommendations of the national respite care facilitator are implemented and to encourage municipalities to offer proactive help to informal carers.
requests the government to monitor how the recommendations of the national respite care facilitator are implemented
verzoekt de regering, te monitoren hoe invulling wordt gegeven aan de aanbevelingen van de landelijk aanjager respijtzorg
Motie van de leden Bergkamp en Sazias over een onderzoek naar medicinale cannabis voor specifieke patiëntgroepen
Asks the government to start a second study into medicinal cannabis effects for specific patient groups, such as children with epilepsy.
requests the government, in parallel with the fundamental research now under way, to start a second study into the effects of specific preparations for specific patient groups
verzoekt de regering, parallel aan het fundamentele onderzoek dat nu gaat lopen, een tweede onderzoek te starten naar de werking van specifieke bereidingen bij specifieke patiëntgroepen
Motie van het lid Sazias over het aantal uren van buurtsportcoaches voor ouderen uitbreiden
Motion asks the government to encourage municipalities to expand hours of neighbourhood sports coaches for older people without reducing hours for youth.
requests the government to encourage municipalities to expand the hours of neighbourhood sports coaches for older people
verzoekt de regering, gemeenten te stimuleren om het aantal uren van buurtsportcoaches voor ouderen uit te breiden
Motie van het lid Van Esch c.s. over een adequaat wettelijk instrumentarium om vanuit het voorzorgsbeginsel te kunnen handelen bij zoönosen
Asks the government to explain in its action plan how adequate legal instruments will be provided to act on the precautionary principle against zoonotic disease threats.
requests the government to make clear in the action plan how adequate legal instruments will be provided
verzoekt de regering, in het plan van aanpak duidelijk te maken hoe zal worden voorzien in een adequaat wettelijk instrumentarium
Amendement van de leden Van Otterloo en Sazias 35570-XVI-69 over middelen voor verschillende vormen van mantelzorgondersteuning
Shifts 10 million euro within the health budget to fund carer support, a carer passport, a national online portal and meeting centres for people with dementia.
With this amendment a total of 10 million euro is freed up for 2021
Met dit amendement wordt voor 2021 een bedrag van in totaal € 10 miljoen vrijgemaakt
Motie van het lid Hijink c.s. over gelijktijdig met de landelijke invoering van CoronaMelder het testbeleid uitbreiden
Asks the government to expand testing policy at the same time as the national rollout of the CoronaMelder app so that everyone notified can get tested quickly.
requests the government, at the same time as the national introduction of CoronaMelder, to expand the testing policy
verzoekt de regering, om gelijktijdig met de landelijke invoering van CoronaMelder het testbeleid uit te breiden
Motie van het lid Laçin c.s. over uniforme maatregelen in de gehele ov-keten om de toegankelijkheid voor mensen met een beperking te waarborgen
Asks the government to quickly introduce uniform COVID measures across the public transport chain guaranteeing accessibility for people with disabilities.
requests the government to come up as quickly as possible with uniform measures
verzoekt de regering, om zo snel als mogelijk met uniforme maatregelen te komen
Motie van het lid Sazias over het heroverwegen van het voornemen om alle reclame voor 20.00 uur op de publieke omroep te verbieden
Asks the government to reconsider its plan to ban all advertising before 20:00 on the public broadcaster.
requests the government to reconsider its intention to prohibit all advertising before 20:00 on the public broadcaster
verzoekt de regering, om haar voornemen om alle reclame voor 20.00 uur op de publieke omroep te verbieden, te heroverwegen
Motie van de leden Westerveld en Sazias over een wetsvoorstel voor een streamingheffing in combinatie met een quotum
Asks the government to prepare a bill for a streaming levy combined with a quota for the audiovisual sector without further delay.
requests the government to stop waiting and prepare a bill on the levy
verzoekt de regering, niet langer te wachten en een wetsvoorstel betreffende de heffing voor te bereiden
Motie van het lid Bruins c.s. over studenten weer meenemen in de jaarlijkse koopkrachtberekeningen van het Nibud
Asks the government to ensure students are again included in the Nibud annual purchasing-power calculations and that the biennial student survey is conducted structurally.
requests the government to ensure that students are again included in the annual purchasing-power calculations of the Nibud
verzoekt de regering, om ervoor zorg te dragen dat studenten weer meegenomen worden in de jaarlijkse koopkrachtberekeningen van het Nibud
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen c.s. over een overbruggingsregeling voor verbetering van de arbeidsvoorwaarden in de kraamzorg
Motion asking the government to arrange a bridging scheme so maternity care working conditions can improve in 2020 before the NZa cost study takes effect.
requests the government, pending the NZa cost study, to arrange a bridging scheme
verzoekt de regering om, in afwachting van het NZa-kostenonderzoek
Motie van het lid Sazias c.s. over beter inzetten op preventie van dementie
Asks the government to examine, with experts if needed, how prevention of dementia can be structurally improved and to inform the House.
requests the government, if necessary in consultation with experts and other parties, to examine how prevention of dementia can be structurally improved
verzoekt de regering om, zo nodig in overleg met deskundigen en andere betrokken partijen, te bezien hoe er structureel beter ingezet kan worden op preventie van dementie
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen c.s. over een onderzoek van het Zorginstituut naar een bredere vergoeding van de CGM-glucosesensor
Asks the government to advise the Zorginstituut to set up a CGM working group of specialists and patients when studying broader reimbursement of glucose sensors.
requests the government to advise the Zorginstituut, in any study on broader reimbursement of the CGM glucose sensor
verzoekt de regering, het Zorginstituut te adviseren, bij een eventueel onderzoek naar bredere vergoeding van de CGM-glucosesensor
Motie van het lid Sazias c.s. over voorkomen dat zorgverzekeraars korten op het eerstelijnsverblijf en geriatische revalidatiezorg
Asks the government to do everything to prevent health insurers cutting payments to care organisations for first-line stays and geriatric rehabilitation.
requests the government to do everything to prevent health insurers from cutting organisations in this way
verzoekt de regering, alles op alles te zetten om te voorkomen dat zorgverzekeraars organisaties op deze wijze korten
Motie van het lid Sazias c.s. over een meerjarig fonds voor veilige seniorenwoningen

qa: Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de minister van Justitie over het stemmen vanuit gevangenissen en tbs-klinieken (ingezonden 11 juni 2010).

An SP MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers why detainees and TBS patients face difficulties voting and why mobile polling stations were not placed in prisons and TBS clinics. The minister said voting by proxy is the same for everyone, that the Electoral Act and municipal discretion govern polling-station placement, and that the Kijvelanden trial went well, leaving extension to municipalities and facility directors.
In principle municipalities are free, in consultation with the directors of prisons and TBS clinics, to designate a polling station there.
Het staat gemeenten in beginsel vrij om in overleg met de desbetreffende directies in gevangenissen en tbs-klinieken een stemlokaal aan te wijzen
Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het niet langer ten uitvoer leggen van elektronische detentie (ingezonden 16 juni 2010).

An MP asks the Justice Minister why electronic detention is being phased out before the promised home-detention bill takes effect, and what consequences this has for staff. The minister says the practice is ending gradually because a legal basis is preferred, that the bill is expected in September, and that staff affected will receive social support and be offered other prison work.
I no longer consider that desirable and therefore a statutory arrangement is called for.
Ik acht dat niet langer wenselijk en daarom is een wettelijke regeling aangewezen.
Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de vervolging van een klokkenluider (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

An SP MP asks the minister whether a whistleblower who leaked a VWA report on slaughterhouse and export-collection-point failings is still being prosecuted, and whether the government should stop the investigation. The minister replies that the person did not follow the official whistleblower procedure, that a criminal complaint led to a Rijksrecherche investigation and a further judicial investigation is ongoing, and that it is not for the minister to influence the prosecutorial decision.
It is not up to me to influence that decision.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg die beslissing te beïnvloeden.
Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over de mogelijkheden van het Pieter Baan Centrum bedreigde verdachten te onderzoeken (ingezonden 14 juni 2010).

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether a threatened suspect could be examined at the Pieter Baan Centre, and why safety could not be guaranteed there. The minister answered that the judge-commissioner chose an outpatient examination, that clinical examination at the centre remains possible with adequate safety measures, and that suspect safety must never block necessary examinations.
The consultation in this case gave no indication for admitting the suspect to the Pieter Baan Centre.
Het consult in casu gaf geen indicatie voor opname van de verdachte in het Pieter Baan Centrum.
Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het afluisteren van geheimhoudersgesprekken in gevangenissen (ingezonden 7 mei 2010).

Ms Van Velzen (SP) asked the Minister of Justice whether conversations between prisoners and confidants such as lawyers could be ruled out from being recorded in prisons, and whether recordings would be destroyed unprocessed. The Minister replied that no lawyer conversation had been recorded in this case, that recordings of confidants are halted and destroyed under instruction, and that the College of Procurators-General will draft a uniform national work instruction on direct eavesdropping in prisons.

If that is the case, the eavesdropping is stopped and the conversation, in accordance with the applicable instruction, without being processed, is immediately submitted to the public prosecutor so that a destruction order can be issued.

Indien dat het geval is, wordt het uitluisteren gestaakt en wordt dit gesprek conform de daarvoor geldende instructie 2 , zonder te worden uitgewerkt, onverwijld voorgelegd aan de officier van justitie teneinde deze een bevel vernietiging te laten afgeven, waarna de gesprekken worden vernietigd.
Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de opvang van 1500 kansarme en zieke dieren (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

MP Van Velzen asks the minister about a court-imposed 1 October 2010 deadline for the Stichting Dierenthuis animal shelter, whether to reactivate the Commissie van Goede Diensten, and what the government will do to limit harm to the animals. The minister confirms awareness of the deadline and that the interim relocation to Lelystad is more difficult than expected, but says the outcome of talks between the municipalities of Almere and Laarbeek cannot be anticipated.
I cannot anticipate the outcome of this consultation.
Op de uitkomsten van dit overleg kan ik niet vooruitlopen.

MPs Van Velzen (SP) asked why military personnel have been lodged in hotels since 2008 at a cost of millions of euros because of a shortage of beds at Gilze-Rijen, and whether cheaper or idle military and COA buildings could be used. The minister answered that about 250 staff are in hotels pending new accommodation (costs €0.2m in 2008, €3m in 2009, €3.1m budgeted for 2010), that a long-term solution will be decided during the year, and that cheaper temporary options are being examined.
For staff who cannot use long-term housing after November 2010, it is being examined whether cheaper interim solutions exist.
Voor de medewerkers die na november 2010 nog geen gebruik kunnen maken van langetermijnhuisvesting, wordt onderzocht of er goedkopere tussentijdse oplossingen zijn.
Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het beperkt opleggen van de gedragsbeïnvloedende maatregel aan moeilijke jeugdigen (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why the juvenile behavioural influence measure (GBM), including foster-family re-education, is imposed far less often than predicted and why most places remain unfilled, and asked about results, costs, outreach to prosecutors and judges, and how to ensure courts impose it. The Minister explained the downward revision of expected numbers after an impact analysis, reported low usage figures, said outcome evidence is not yet reliable, and listed information efforts and expanded pre-sentence reports, while stating that imposing the measure is for the judge.
It is for the judge to impose a behavioural influence measure.
Het is aan de rechter om een gedragsbeïnvloedende maatregel op te leggen.
Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over de noodzaak van gemeenten om de noodopvang voor asielzoekers weer te openen (ingezonden 7 april 2010).

Van Velzen (SP) asks the Justice Minister how he responds to municipalities' claim that they must reopen emergency shelter for asylum seekers because the government cannot return rejected asylum seekers from the Ter Apel restricted-freedom location, and questions whether all those ending up on the street are at fault and whether municipalities have a duty of care. Minister Hirsch Ballin answers that there is no real reason to reopen emergency shelter, cites structural measures, states that returnees are responsible for departure, and says the 2007 agreement with the VNG is fulfilled so municipalities should not reopen shelter.
There is no real reason to proceed to reopening emergency shelter facilities.
Er is geen reële aanleiding om tot heropening van noodopvangvoorzieningen over te gaan.
Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het afschaffen van onderwijs en opleidingen in detentie (ingezonden 13 april 2010).

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice whether reducing education in Krimpen aan den IJssel prison, and abolishing a special parent-child visit, conflicts with the Modernisering Gevangeniswezen programme. The Minister says education is not being cut to two hours per week, staffing is not yet formally fixed, the site will not be a pilot, and parent-child visits continue four times a year with a new weekend schedule.
It is in any case not correct that from 1 September 2010 the number of education hours will be cut back to two hours per week.
Het klopt in ieder geval niet dat per 1 september 2010 het aantal onderwijsuren wordt teruggesnoeid tot twee uur per week.

qa: Antwoord vragen Smilde en De Rouwe over het artikel ‘Sionsberg gaat geboortezorg afbouwen’

The minister answered that the hospital's chosen profile removes acute and obstetric care, that ambulance access remains within 45 minutes, and that an independent working group will propose a replacement plan with the College Perinatale Zorg involved.
The Inspectorate will assess the plan, once it has been established by the parties, against the quality and accessibility standards.
De Inspectie toetst het plan, nadat dat is vastgesteld door partijen, aan de normen voor kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid.

An MP asks the health minister about reports that the EU recognises the special position of Dutch health insurers under Solvency II, and whether DNB or EIOPA should set the solvency relief. The minister confirms further negotiation is needed, that the government seeks relief reflecting the risk-equalisation system, and that a Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit report on market entry will be sent to the Chamber.
Soon I will send the Chamber a report that the Dutch Health Care Authority recently prepared on market entry options for health insurers.
Binnenkort stuur ik de Kamer een rapport dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit onlangs heeft opgesteld over de toetredingsmogelijkheden voor zorgverzekeraars.

An MP asked the health minister about fragmentation hindering nationwide e-health and what the government would do to stimulate it. The minister acknowledges e-health is not yet deployed at scale, points to a stakeholder initiative, and promises a letter to parliament before the summer recess.
I will inform the House about the cabinet's plans regarding e-health.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren over de plannen van het kabinet ten aanzien van e-health.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Smilde over een omstreden maagchirurg in Duitsland

The minister said the IGZ can inform foreign authorities, that a BIG-register entry for foreign measures is being introduced, and that EU-level information exchange and a warning mechanism are being pursued.
First, the IGZ can inform the competent authorities in the receiving country if the professional concerned is known to those authorities.
Ten eerste kan de IGZ de bevoegde autoriteiten in het ontvangende land informeren ingeval de betrokken beroepsbeoefenaar bij die autoriteiten bekend is.
