In light of this, I consider it inopportune for the Netherlands to notify the Council of Europe that protection of Low Saxon will henceforth take place in accordance with at least 35 provisions of Part III of the European Charter.

Naar aanleiding hiervan acht ik het daarom niet opportuun dat Nederland bij de Raad van Europa kenbaar maakt dat bescherming van het Nedersaksisch voortaan plaatsvindt conform ten minste 35 bepalingen van Deel III van het Europees Handvest.
Antwoord vragen Smilde, Bruins Slot en Blanksma-van den Heuvel over het bericht "dure verzekering voor dikke mensen"

Three CDA MPs asked how a person of normal health but high BMI (1.60 m, 90 kg) can pay higher insurance premiums, and how insurers assess health and lifestyle. The minister explained that insurers may use lifestyle factors including overweight for life and disability insurance, that assessment follows insurers' own policies within legal limits, and that health insurance premiums must generally be uniform.
Insurers may not ask more questions than are included in this model health declaration.
Verzekeraars mogen niet meer vragen stellen dan op deze model-gezondheidsverklaring zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Smilde en Ferrier over de gevaren van totaal resistente tbc

CDA MPs Smilde and Ferrier asked about the danger of totally drug-resistant tuberculosis in India, Europe and the Netherlands, the Dutch preparedness plans, funding for new TB drugs, policy coherence and travel advice. The minister answered that resistant TB is significant but TDR-TB has not yet been found in the Netherlands, that existing plans, expert working groups and screening are in place, and that new drug development is largely the pharmaceutical industry's task, with some Dutch funding and no change to travel advice.
TDR-TB has not yet been observed in the Netherlands.
TDR-tbc is nog niet waargenomen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Smilde over het vertrek van de belastingdienst uit Emmen

MPs Wolbert and Smilde asked whether the Tax Authority's departure from Emmen, costing about 300 jobs, had been weighed against regional employment and service to citizens. The minister replied that no decisions on relocation have been taken, that the regional impact will be assessed in the Drenthe office masterplan with the province, and that savings phase in through 2020.
Antwoord vragen Smilde en Haverkamp over traumahelikopters

MPs Smilde and Haverkamp asked the health minister whether a study finding no proven added value of trauma helicopters over regular ambulance transport was valid and what criteria govern dispatch. The minister disagreed with the study's conclusion, explained the dispatch criteria, and said no obstacles are known to limiting helicopter response.
I think differently about that; in my view that conclusion cannot be drawn.
Daar denk ik anders over, die conclusie kan naar mijn idee niet worden getrokken.

Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Smilde over het artikel “Floortje Mols, Melissa S.Y. Thong, Pauline Vissers, Tamar Nijsten, Lonneke V. van de Poll-Franse: ‘Socio-economic implications of cancer survivorship: results from the

MPs Omtzigt and Smilde asked the health minister about a study showing former cancer patients, especially younger ones, struggled to obtain life insurance or mortgages, and whether standard acceptance protocols could be pushed for or the Wet op de medische keuringen tightened. The minister said life insurance has no statutory acceptance duty, saw no reason to change the law now, left responsibility largely with insurers, and noted the NFK is in talks with the insurers' association.
For now I see no reason to amend the law.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om de wet aan te passen.
Vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over spoedzorg in Dokkum (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

CDA MPs asked the health minister about the closure of acute and obstetric care at hospital De Sionsberg in Dokkum, and how access to care and the 45-minute response time would be guaranteed. The minister answered that the hospital cannot meet quality norms given its size, that the Inspectorate is requiring a care policy plan, and that extra ambulance capacity and UMCG backup have been arranged.
The IGZ will continue to closely monitor De Sionsberg to see whether the plans are responsibly developed and implemented.
De IGZ blijft De Sionsberg intensief volgen om te zien of de plannen verantwoord worden uitgewerkt en geïmplementeerd.
Vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over borgbaarheid maatschappelijk vastgoed (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

CDA MPs asked the health minister whether housing corporations can finance community care points (zorgsteunpunten) and whether WSW guarantees can cover premises housing GPs and therapists, given the WSW's stance that these fall outside the DAEB category. The government answered that the WSW talks concluded GPs and therapists are not DAEB-eligible, while encouraging corporations to build shared care facilities and noting limits on state aid for GP premises.
The conversation with the WSW has been concluded, with the indication that GPs and therapists are not classified in the DAEB category.
Het gesprek met het WSW is afgerond, waarbij is aangegeven, dat huisartsen en therapeuten niet tot de daeb-categorie worden gerekend.

Vragen van het lid Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er steeds meer mensen zijn die hun zorgpremie niet kunnen betalen (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether she knew of reports that more people cannot pay their health insurance premiums, how many are affected, whether stricter debt enforcement is linked, and how arrears can be prevented. The minister acknowledged the reports, said the number of affected people in the state premium regime is known but overall arrears figures are not, and promised to intensify preventive measures and inform parliament in autumn.
How many people have a payment arrear of less than six months with their health insurer, or how many people ask their insurer for a payment arrangement, is not known to me.

Hoe groot het aantal mensen is met een betalingsachterstand van minder dan zes maanden bij hun zorgverzekeraar of hoeveel mensen hun zorgverzekeraar vragen om een betalingsregeling is mij niet bekend.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de stroomstoring en de veiligheid in de ziekenhuizen van Ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about a power outage at a Twente hospital group that disabled emergency power, Dutch hospital emergency-power standards, fire-safety enforcement and dwangsommen imposed by two municipalities, and follow-up to a 2006 fatal operating-room fire. The minister answered that standards were addressed in an earlier reply, that municipalities are enforcing fire rules with a year-end deadline, and that the IGZ judged the hospital's post-fire measures adequate in 2009, while declining to commit to a further check beyond a ministry meeting with the board.
At the time the IGZ concluded that the measures were sufficient and continued its inspection work in the usual national manner.
De IGZ heeft destijds geconcludeerd dat de maatregelen voldoende waren en haar inspectie werkzaamheden op de gebruikelijke landelijke wijze voortgezet.
Vragen van het lid Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de inzet van Poolse immigranten door Oranjeverenigingen (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether he is concerned that a local Oranje association paid Polish immigrants to fill volunteer roles, whether other municipalities did the same, and whether the government will help recruit volunteers for Queen's Day and 4-5 May. The minister replies that these associations are independent and responsible for their own activities, declines to judge the Lienden decision, and says national government involvement does not fit local celebrations, though it contributes to national events.
Oranje associations are independent associations that are themselves responsible for organising their activities.
Oranjeverenigingen zijn onafhankelijke verenigingen, die zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor de organisatie van hun activiteiten.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert (PvdA), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het recht van grensarbeiders op een Persoons Gebonden Budget (PGB) in Duitsland (ingezo

MPs asked whether Dutch premium-paying workers living in Germany can obtain a PGB or German Pflegegeld, why the CVZ website suggests otherwise, and what steps the minister will take to change EU rules or allow PGB access. The state secretary answered that PGB is a subsidy not a legal right, EU case law (Molenaar) classes Pflegegeld as a benefit not a service, and the government will examine the issue when legislating the PGB.
Legislating the PGB was agreed in the Coalition and Toleration Agreement.
Het wettelijk regelen van het PGB is afgesproken in het Regeer- en Gedoogakkoord

Vragen van de leden Mulder (VVD) en Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het laagdrempelig inzetten van ambulances door de ambulancedienst Brabant-Midden-West-Noord (ingezonden 7 maart

MPs Mulder and Smilde ask the health minister about a regional ambulance service director's memo urging low-threshold ambulance dispatch to avoid budget cuts. The minister finds this unacceptable, says the convenant's incentives were never meant to cause low-threshold dispatch, and says the zorgverzekeraar and IGZ will investigate if needed.

Vragen van de leden Van Miltenburg (VVD) en Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport inzake de DNA-test voor conceptie van VU Medisch Centrum (VUMC) (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Van Miltenburg and Smilde ask the health minister whether a VUMC preconception DNA carrier test for cystic fibrosis fits Dutch law, whether prospective parents are adequately informed, and whether the Health Council should be asked to advise. The minister replies that the test falls outside the Wet op het bevolkingsonderzoek because it offers preventive options before conception, that she cannot judge the information given by VUMC, and that she sees no reason to request Health Council advice.
No, I see no reason for that.
Nee, ik zie daar geen aanleiding voor.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag en Smilde beiden (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Bewoner verpleeghuis kan kamer kwijtraken» (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

CDA MPs asked the state secretary about reports that nursing home residents may lose their room during hospital stays, and about the rights of residents and the planned separation of housing and care. The state secretary said residents keep their room for at least fourteen days during hospitalisation, that the NZa is studying absence rules, and that the consequences of separating housing and care are under study.
Research is currently being carried out into the consequences of separating housing and care.
Momenteel wordt er nog onderzoek gedaan naar de consequenties van het scheiden van wonen en zorg.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag, Omtzigt en Smilde (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over voornemens tot overheveling van de kraamafdeling van het ziekenhuis in Almelo naar Hengelo (ingezonde

CDA MPs asked the health minister about ZGT's plan to move the obstetric ward from Almelo to Hengelo, covering access, safety, capacity, home-birth rates, and the insurers' view. The minister answered that no final decision has been taken, that concentration is possible for quality reasons, that Hengelo's current capacity is insufficient, and that the IGZ can intervene if care quality is at risk.
Through the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) I am authorised and willing to intervene if the quality of care is at stake.
Via de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) ben ik bevoegd en bereid in te grijpen als de kwaliteit van zorg in het geding is.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over «onafhankelijke» vergelijkingssites voor zorgverzekeringen (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister whether comparison site Independer gives preferential treatment to insurers paying commission, whether it discloses its funders, and how reliable information on health insurance comparison sites can be promoted, including via the NZa. The minister replied that Independer's conduct is supervised by the AFM, that the term 'independent' is not defined in law but will be reconsidered, that the NZa oversees insurers' information and has rated comparison sites since 2007, and that the market should otherwise be left to decide.
No, I leave this to the market.
Nee, dit laat ik over aan de markt.
Vragen van het lid Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de sluiting van de Spoedeisende Eerste Hulp (ingezonden 28 juli 2010).

MP Smilde asks the health minister about a RIVM study suggesting that closing the emergency department at either Stadskanaal or Winschoten would still leave residents within the 45-minute norm, and why this differs from earlier advice and from an ARGO study. The minister confirms the RIVM findings, explains the 45-minute norm is applied as a spreading norm rather than a performance measure, and commits to a response in the autumn after a further ambulance-times note.
I am willing to respond to the studies in the autumn, once the note on ambulance response, treatment and transport times is also available.
Ik ben bereid in het najaar te reageren op de onderzoeken, nadat ook de notitie over de ambulance respons- behandel en bezorgtijd beschikbaar is.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over samenwerkingsverbanden tussen huisartsen (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Health whether VAT rules unnecessarily frustrate cooperation between GPs and what steps will be taken. The minister replied that the issue is covered in an earlier letter of 11 May and referred to that letter for the answers.

Since in that letter – also on behalf of the Minister of Finance – I discussed the problem extensively, the (im)possibilities for practice and the steps to be taken, I refer integrally to the earlier letter for the answers to the questions now asked.

Aangezien ik in die brief – ook mede namens de minister van Financiën – uitgebreid op de problematiek ben ingegaan, de (on)mogelijkheden voor de praktijk heb besproken en de te nemen stappen heb aangegeven, verwijs ik voor de beantwoording van de nu gestelde vragen integraal naar eerder genoemde brief.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het kwijtraken van collectieve zorgverzekering na ontslag (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

MPs Smilde and Omtzigt asked the health minister whether insurers may withdraw the 10% collective discount when employees lose their jobs, and whether a regulation should guarantee the discount until year-end. The minister confirmed awareness, said insurers and collectives may agree arrangements, and declined to legislate, leaving it to insurers.
Since the law provides sufficient scope to make such agreements, I do not intend to legally require insurers to give a dismissed employee a discount until the end of the year.

Aangezien de wet voldoende ruimte biedt om dit soort afspraken te maken, ben ik niet voornemens het wettelijk voor te schrijven aan verzekeraars dat zij een ontslagen werknemer tot het eind van het jaar een korting moeten geven.
Vragen van het lid Smilde (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over kiesrecht voor mensen met een verstandelijke beperking (ingezonden 29 april 2010).

Smilde (CDA) asks whether care homes discard voting passes of residents with intellectual disabilities and what will be done to ensure they can vote. The state secretary acknowledges reports of passes being discarded, pledges to again write to care institutions, and declines to legislate assisted voting, citing the personal nature of the vote.

With a view to the upcoming House of Representatives election, I am willing to again write to the mental health institutions to point out that they must hand out voting passes to their residents on time.
Met het oog op de komende Tweede Kamerverkiezing ben ik bereid opnieuw de ggz-instellingen aan te schrijven om hen er op te wijzen dat zij de stempas tijdig aan hun bewoners moeten uitreiken.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Jager (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Menzis legt Refaja wil op» (ingezonden 13 april 2010).

The CDA MPs Smilde and Jager asked the health minister about reports that insurer Menzis wants to reduce hospital capacity in East Groningen, including whether only one hospital should remain near the A7 and the consequences for acute care access. The minister replied that Menzis has no concrete proposals yet, that the government stands behind the insurer's responsibility in consultation with hospitals, and that RIVM is analysing acute care accessibility scenarios, with results to be sent to parliament.
I will inform you in writing about the accessibility of acute care in the region once I receive the outcomes.
Ik zal u na ontvangst van de uitkomsten schriftelijke informeren over de bereikbaarheid van de acute zorg in de regio.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Jager (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Menzis legt Refaja wil op» (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

The CDA MPs ask whether it falls within a health insurer's duty of care to intervene so actively in a hospital's new-build plans and push for a merger with another hospital. The minister answers that securing care is primarily the insurer's responsibility, that contract negotiations are the main tool, and that discussions on mergers and new builds can be necessary for efficient, high-quality care.
Which measures are necessary to ensure the health insurer can meet its duty of care is in principle up to the health insurer itself.
Welke maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn om ervoor te zorgen dat de zorgverzekeraar aan zijn zorgplicht kan voldoen is in principe aan de zorgverzekeraar zelf.

m: Motie van de leden Claassen en Ten Hove over uitstel van de wijziging van de Regeling ambulancezorgvoorzieningen
Asks the government to postpone the amendment of the ambulance care regulation on the meldkamer function until 1 January 2027.
requests the government to postpone the introduction of the amendment to the Ambulance Care Facilities Regulation regarding the control room function until 1 January 2027
verzoekt de regering om de invoering van de wijziging van de Regeling ambulancezorgvoorzieningen in verband met de uitoefening van de meldkamerfunctie tot 1 januari 2027 uit te stellen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Hove over het bericht dat de eerste wijkkliniek die ouderen helpt revalideren ondanks het succesvolle concept toch onverwachts moet stoppen en zorgverleners hierdoor compleet verrast zi

An MP from the PVV asked the Health State Secretary about the closure of the Amsterdam wijkkliniek for elderly rehabilitation despite its success, and about the new Zorgverzekeraars Nederland vision. The State Secretary answered that the insurers' vision is not yet shared by providers and professional bodies, that the NZa and ZiNL will examine the closure with the parties involved, and that it is not her role to force insurers to contract specific providers.
It does not fit my role to require health insurers to contract care with specific providers.
Het past niet bij mijn rol om zorgverzekeraars te verplichten om zorg te contracteren bij specifieke zorgaanbieders.
Vragen van het lid Algra (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de WABO (ingezonden 21 mei 2010).

An MP asked the housing minister about reports of possible further delays to the WABO's introduction, training gaps at municipalities, and measures to ensure a 1 July 2010 start. The minister replied that the introduction date is now 1 October 2010 under the entry-into-force decree, that training is provided and municipalities and provinces must embed it, and that IPO and VNG committed to a careful implementation.
The entry-into-force decree (Staatsblad 2010, 231) sets the introduction date at 1 October this year.
In het inwerkingstredings KB ( Staatsblad 2010, 231 ) is opgenomen dat de invoeringsdatum 1 oktober dit jaar is.

Vragen van het lid Algra (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken over toeristenbelasting (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An MP asked the government about reported tourist tax increases of up to 122% and municipal discretion over the tax, and asked which municipalities levy it and whether they provide a counter-service. The state secretary answered that municipalities are autonomous in setting the tax, provided a list of 311 levying municipalities, reported typical rates, and said the revenue is freely spendable with no direct link to a counter-service.
A municipality is autonomous in deciding whether to levy, raise or lower the tourist tax and in setting the conditions.
Een gemeente is autonoom in het al dan niet heffen, verhogen c.q. verlagen van de toeristenbelasting en het bepalen van de voorwaarden.
